    PROCEDURE SetDefaultQuantity@62();
    VAR
      SalesSetup@1000 : Record 311;
    BEGIN
      SalesSetup.GET;
      IF SalesSetup."Default Quantity to Ship" = SalesSetup."Default Quantity to Ship"::Blank THEN BEGIN
        IF ("Document Type" = "Document Type"::Order) OR ("Document Type" = "Document Type"::Quote) THEN BEGIN
          "Qty. to Ship" := 0;
          "Qty. to Ship (Base)" := 0;
          "Qty. to Invoice" := 0;
          "Qty. to Invoice (Base)" := 0;
        END;
        IF "Document Type" = "Document Type"::"Return Order" THEN BEGIN
          "Return Qty. to Receive" := 0;
          "Return Qty. to Receive (Base)" := 0;
          "Qty. to Invoice" := 0;
          "Qty. to Invoice (Base)" := 0;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdatePrePaymentAmounts@64();
    VAR
      ShipmentLine@1000 : Record 111;
      SalesOrderLine@1001 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT ShipmentLine.GET("Shipment No.","Shipment Line No.") THEN BEGIN
        "Prepmt Amt to Deduct" := 0;
        "Prepmt VAT Diff. to Deduct" := 0;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF SalesOrderLine.GET(SalesOrderLine."Document Type"::Order,ShipmentLine."Order No.",ShipmentLine."Order Line No.") THEN BEGIN
          "Prepmt Amt to Deduct" :=
            ROUND((SalesOrderLine."Prepmt. Amt. Inv." - SalesOrderLine."Prepmt Amt Deducted") *
                   Quantity / (SalesOrderLine.Quantity - SalesOrderLine."Quantity Invoiced"),Currency."Amount Rounding Precision");
          "Prepmt VAT Diff. to Deduct" := "Prepayment VAT Difference" - "Prepmt VAT Diff. Deducted";
        END ELSE BEGIN
          "Prepmt Amt to Deduct" := 0;
          "Prepmt VAT Diff. to Deduct" := 0;
        END;
      END;

      GetSalesHeader;
      IF SalesHeader."Prices Including VAT" THEN BEGIN
        "Prepmt. Line Amount" := ROUND("Prepmt Amt to Deduct" * (1 + ("Prepayment VAT %" / 100)),Currency."Amount Rounding Precision");
        "Prepmt. Amt. Incl. VAT" := "Prepmt. Line Amount";
      END ELSE BEGIN
        "Prepmt. Line Amount" := "Prepmt Amt to Deduct";
        "Prepmt. Amt. Incl. VAT" := ROUND("Prepmt Amt to Deduct" * (1 + ("Prepayment VAT %" / 100)),Currency."Amount Rounding Precision"
      );
      END;
      "Prepmt. Amt. Inv." := "Prepmt. Line Amount";
      "Prepayment Amount" := "Prepmt Amt to Deduct";
      "Prepmt. VAT Base Amt." := "Prepmt Amt to Deduct";
      "Prepmt. Amount Inv. Incl. VAT" := "Prepmt. Line Amount";
      "Prepmt Amt Deducted" := 0;
    END;

    PROCEDURE ZeroAmountLine@65(QtyType@1000 : 'General,Invoicing,Shipping') : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF Type = Type::" " THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);
      IF Quantity = 0 THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);
      IF ("Unit Price" = 0) OR ("Line Discount %" = 100) THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);
      IF QtyType = QtyType::Invoicing THEN
        IF "Qty. to Invoice" = 0 THEN
          EXIT(TRUE);
      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    END;

    PROCEDURE CancelSPOLineOK@1100409001(VAR ErrMsg@1100409000 : Text[80];VAR SourcingCancelAllowed@1100409007 : Boolean;SkipReservation@1100409019 : Boolean) DelivStatCancelAllowed : Boolean;
    VAR
      lParentLine@1100409013 : Record 37;
      lSalesLine@1100409018 : Record 37;
      lSalesLineStored@1100409017 : Record 37;
      lReservEntry@1100409001 : Record 337;
      lText001@1100409003 : TextConst 'ENU=%1 %2  is not a %3';
      lText002@1100409004 : TextConst 'ENU=%1 %2 is already %3';
      lText003@1100409005 : TextConst 'ENU=%1 %2 has %3 %4';
      lText004@1100409006 : TextConst 'ENU=%1 %2 has %3 %4 and %5 %6';
      lText005@1100409002 : TextConst 'ENU=%1 needs to be canceled for %2 %3';
      lSpecialOrderUtils@1100409008 : Codeunit 10012702;
      lText006@1100409009 : TextConst 'ENU=%1 %2 is linked to Purhcase Order %3';
      lPODocNo@1100409010 : Code[20];
      lTODocNo@1100409011 : Code[20];
      lText007@1100409012 : TextConst 'ENU=%1 %2 is linked to Transfer Order %3';
      lText008@1100409015 : TextConst 'ENU=%1 %2 is linked to non existing line %3';
      lText009@1100409016 : TextConst 'ENU=%1 %2 is automatically linked to %3 %4';
      lCancelPermitOnParent@1100409014 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      //LS
      SourcingCancelAllowed := FALSE;
      CLEAR(ErrMsg);

      IF NOT("Retail Special Order") THEN BEGIN
        ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText001,FIELDCAPTION("Line No."),"Line No.",FIELDCAPTION("Retail Special Order"));
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      IF ("Sourcing Status" = "Sourcing Status"::Canceled)
      AND ("Delivery Status" = "Delivery Status"::Canceled) THEN BEGIN
        ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText002,Type,"No.",FORMAT("Sourcing Status"));
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      IF ("Delivery Status" = "Delivery Status"::Canceled) THEN BEGIN
        ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText002,Type,"No.",FORMAT("Delivery Status"));
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      IF "Cancel Permitted" = "Cancel Permitted"::Never THEN BEGIN
        ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText003,Type,"No.",FIELDCAPTION("Cancel Permitted"),FORMAT("Cancel Permitted"));
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      //Add. chrg tests.
      IF ("Add.charge code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
        IF "Linked to Line No." <> 0 THEN BEGIN
          CLEAR(lParentLine);
          lSalesLineStored.COPY(Rec);
          IF GET("Document Type","Document No.","Linked to Line No.") THEN
            lParentLine := Rec;
          Rec.COPY(lSalesLineStored);
        END;
        IF ("Linked to Line No." <> 0) AND (lParentLine."Line No." <> "Linked to Line No.") THEN BEGIN
          ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText008,Description,"No.","Linked to Line No.");
          EXIT(FALSE);
        END;

        IF "Add.Charge Option" = "Add.Charge Option"::Automatic THEN BEGIN
          IF ("Linked to Line No." <> 0)  THEN BEGIN
            ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText009,Type,"No.",lParentLine.Type,lParentLine."No.");
            EXIT(FALSE);
          END
          ELSE BEGIN
            lSalesLineStored.COPY(Rec);
            SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
            SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
            SETFILTER("Line No.",'<>%1',"Line No.");
            SETRANGE("Add.charge code",'');
            SETFILTER("Delivery Status",'<= %1',"Delivery Status"::Delivered);
            IF FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
              ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText009,lSalesLineStored.Type,lSalesLineStored."No.",
                FORMAT(lSalesLineStored."Document Type"),lSalesLineStored."Document No.");
              Rec.COPY(lSalesLineStored);
              EXIT(FALSE);
            END;
            Rec.COPY(lSalesLineStored);
          END;
        END;

        IF "Linked to Line No." <> 0 THEN BEGIN
          lCancelPermitOnParent := lParentLine."Cancel Permitted";
          IF "Add.Charge Option" = "Add.Charge Option"::Ask THEN
            lParentLine."Cancel Permitted" := lParentLine."Cancel Permitted"::Always;
          EXIT(lParentLine.CancelSPOLineOK(ErrMsg,SourcingCancelAllowed,TRUE));
          lParentLine."Cancel Permitted" := lCancelPermitOnParent;
        END;
        SourcingCancelAllowed := TRUE;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      IF "Cancel Permitted" = "Cancel Permitted"::"Before Sourcing" THEN BEGIN
        IF "Sourcing Status" = "Sourcing Status"::Sourced THEN BEGIN
          ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText004,Type,"No.",FIELDCAPTION("Cancel Permitted"),FORMAT("Cancel Permitted"),
                                        FIELDCAPTION("Sourcing Status"),FORMAT("Sourcing Status"));
          EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
      END;

      // "Cancel permitted" = always
      // if there are no outstanding documents (Purchase orders or Transfer orders) or reservations, cancellation is ok.
      // first we have to be able to change the delivery status to Cancelled.
      IF ("Delivery Status" = "Delivery Status"::Delivered) THEN BEGIN
        ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText003,Type,"No.",FIELDCAPTION("Delivery Status"),FORMAT(xRec."Delivery Status"));
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      SourcingCancelAllowed := TRUE;

      //LS6.20.01-03 -
      IF SkipReservation THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);
      //LS6.20.01-03 +

      //if po then exit false
      lPODocNo := lSpecialOrderUtils.getPurchaseOrderNo(Rec);
      IF lPODocNo <> '' THEN BEGIN
        ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText006,Type,"No.",lPODocNo);
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      //if TO then exit false
      lTODocNo :=  lSpecialOrderUtils.getTransferOrderNo(Rec);
      IF lTODocNo <> '' THEN BEGIN
        ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText007,Type,"No.",lTODocNo);
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      //are there any reservations from this line.
      lReservEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Source ID","Source Ref. No.","Source Type",
                                 "Source Subtype","Source Batch Name",
                                 "Source Prod. Order Line");

      lReservEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Sales Line");
      lReservEntry.SETRANGE("Source Subtype","Document Type");
      lReservEntry.SETRANGE("Source ID","Document No.");
      lReservEntry.SETRANGE("Source Ref. No.","Line No.");
      IF lReservEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        ErrMsg := STRSUBSTNO(lText005,lReservEntry.TABLECAPTION,Type,"No.");
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CalcDueDate@8053002() Res_DueDate : Date;
    VAR
      L_recItem@8053000 : Record 27;
      L_CompareDueDate@8053002 : Date;
      SalesHeader_L@8053001 : Record 36;
      CMCSetup_L@8053003 : Record 8052982;
      recCustomerActivity_L@8053004 : Record 8053019;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20110601-Wi00-CMC01.04
      // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Calcul de la date d''ch'ance
      // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      Res_DueDate := 0D;

      IF "Document Type" = "Document Type"::Order THEN BEGIN
        CLEAR(SalesHeader_L);
        SalesHeader_L.GET("Document Type","Document No.");
        CMCSetup_L.GET;
        IF NOT (recCustomerActivity_L.GET("Sell-to Customer No.", Item."Activity Code")) THEN
          IF CMCSetup_L."Copy Due Date S.O.Lines" THEN
            Res_DueDate := SalesHeader_L."Due Date";
        IF Type = Type::Item THEN BEGIN
          IF L_recItem.GET("No.") THEN BEGIN
            IF L_recItem."Due Date" <> 0D THEN BEGIN
              // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
              // Date d''ch'ance Article (Comparaison sur Jour/Mois)
              // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
              L_CompareDueDate := DMY2DATE(DATE2DMY(L_recItem."Due Date", 1),
                                           DATE2DMY(L_recItem."Due Date", 2),
                                           DATE2DMY(WORKDATE, 3));

              IF WORKDATE <= L_CompareDueDate THEN
                Res_DueDate := L_CompareDueDate
              ELSE
                Res_DueDate := DMY2DATE(DATE2DMY(L_recItem."Due Date", 1),
                                        DATE2DMY(L_recItem."Due Date", 2),
                                        DATE2DMY(WORKDATE, 3)+1);
            END ELSE BEGIN
              L_recItem.CALCFIELDS("Specie Due Date");
              IF L_recItem."Specie Due Date" <> 0D THEN BEGIN
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
                // Date d''ch'ance EspSce Article (Comparaison sur Jour/Mois)
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
                L_CompareDueDate := DMY2DATE(DATE2DMY(L_recItem."Specie Due Date", 1),
                                             DATE2DMY(L_recItem."Specie Due Date", 2),
                                             DATE2DMY(WORKDATE, 3));

              IF WORKDATE <= L_CompareDueDate THEN
                Res_DueDate := L_CompareDueDate
              ELSE
                Res_DueDate := DMY2DATE(DATE2DMY(L_recItem."Specie Due Date", 1),
                                        DATE2DMY(L_recItem."Specie Due Date", 2),
                                        DATE2DMY(WORKDATE, 3)+1);
              END;
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;

      // --> 20161007-WI00-ADV01.01.00-2859-CJY01
      IF (("Document Type" = "Document Type"::"Return Order") AND ("Source Order No." = '')) THEN BEGIN
        CLEAR(SalesHeader_L);
        SalesHeader_L.GET("Document Type","Document No.");
        CMCSetup_L.GET;
        IF CMCSetup_L."Copy Due Date S.O.Lines" THEN
          Res_DueDate := SalesHeader_L."Due Date";
      END;
      // <-- 20161007-WI00-ADV01.01.00-2859-CJY01
      EXIT(Res_DueDate);
      // <-- 20110601-Wi00-CMC01.04
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetPaymentTerm@8053003() Res_PaymentTerm : Code[10];
    VAR
      L_recItem@8053000 : Record 27;
      L_recSalesHeader@8053002 : Record 36;
      L_recCustomerActivity@8053001 : Record 8053019;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20110601-Wi00-CMC01.04
      Res_PaymentTerm := '';

      IF L_recSalesHeader.GET("Document Type", "Document No.") THEN BEGIN
        IF Type = Type::Item THEN BEGIN
          IF L_recItem.GET("No.") THEN BEGIN
            IF L_recCustomerActivity.GET("Sell-to Customer No.", L_recItem."Activity Code") THEN
              Res_PaymentTerm := L_recCustomerActivity."Payment Terms Code"
            ELSE
              Res_PaymentTerm := L_recSalesHeader."Payment Terms Code";
          END;
        END;
      END;

      EXIT(Res_PaymentTerm);
      // --> 20110601-Wi00-CMC01.04
    END;

    PROCEDURE f_DeleteAttachedTaxLine@8053040(L_line@8053002 : Integer);
    VAR
      SalesLine_L@8053001 : Record 37;
      Tax_L@8053000 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20120316-Wi00-CMC01.04.05-JLT01
      // supprime les lignes des taxes sur une ligne rattach'e ou toutes les taxes si ligne=0

      FOR Tax_L := 0 TO 2 DO BEGIN
        SalesLine_L.RESET;
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
        CASE Tax_L OF
          0 :
            IF L_line=0 THEN
              SalesLine_L.SETFILTER("CVO Item Attached Line",'>%1', 0)
            ELSE
              SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("CVO Item Attached Line", "Line No.");
          1 :
            IF L_line=0 THEN
              SalesLine_L.SETFILTER("CVO Corn Item Attached Line",'>%1', 0)
            ELSE
              SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("CVO Corn Item Attached Line", "Line No.");
          2 :
            IF L_line=0 THEN
              SalesLine_L.SETFILTER("RPD Item Attached Line",'>%1',0)
            ELSE
              SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("RPD Item Attached Line", "Line No.");
        END;
        SalesLine_L.SETFILTER("Qty. Shipped Not Invoiced",'<>%1',0);
        IF SalesLine_L.FINDSET THEN
          ERROR(Text8053021,Tax_L);
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Qty. Shipped Not Invoiced");
        IF SalesLine_L.FINDSET THEN
          SalesLine_L.DELETEALL(TRUE);
      END;
      // <-- 20120316-Wi00-CMC01.04.05-JLT01
    END;

    PROCEDURE GenerateTaxLine@8053039(VAR SalesLine_P@8053005 : Record 37);
    VAR
      CMCSetup_L@50000 : Record 8052982;
      Customer_L@8053004 : Record 18;
      Item_L@50001 : Record 27;
      CMCActiveSubstCattemp_P@50002 : TEMPORARY Record 8053024;
      ItemUnitMeasure_L@50007 : Record 5404;
      SalesLine_L@8053000 : Record 37;
      SalesHeader_L@8053007 : Record 36;
      CollectionTax_L@8053011 : Record 8053007;
      CollectedTax_L@8053010 : Record 8053006;
      UnitsMeasureCMC_L@8053009 : Record 8053025;
      UnitsMeasureCMC2_L@8053008 : Record 8053025;
      Coeff_L@8053003 : Decimal;
      ItemOfUnit_L@8053002 : Record 5404;
      ItemOfUnit2_L@8053001 : Record 5404;
      TaxUnitPrice_L@8053012 : Decimal;
      recTax_L@8053006 : Record 8053523;
      CanCVO_L@8053013 : Boolean;
      CanCVMCorn_L@8053014 : Boolean;
      CanRPD_L@8053015 : Boolean;
      RpdDate_L@60000 : Date;
      RecSalesInvoiceHeader_L@60001 : Record 112;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20120326-Wi00-CMC01.04.05-JLT01
      // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Dans cette fonction, on g'nSre toutes les taxes sur un article
      // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // --> 20150818-APP21-TER01.01.00-2147-FBE01
      IF NOT SuspendTaxInsert_G THEN BEGIN
      // <-- 20150818-APP21-TER01.01.00-2147-FBE01
        WITH SalesLine_P DO BEGIN
          IF "Document Type" IN ["Document Type"::Order,"Document Type"::"Return Order","Document Type"::Invoice,
            "Document Type"::"Credit Memo"]
          THEN BEGIN
            // pas de taxes sur les clients n'goces
            IF NOT Customer_L.GET("Bill-to Customer No.") THEN
              EXIT;
            IF Customer_L."Trading Customer (Tax Exempt)" THEN
              EXIT;
            IF Type = Type::Item THEN BEGIN
              IF Item_L.GET("No.") THEN BEGIN
                CMCSetup_L.GET;
                SalesHeader_L.GET("Document Type", "Document No.");
                // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                // G'n'ration de la ligne CVO
                // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                IF Item_L."CVO Credit" THEN BEGIN
                  // --> 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                  CollectionTax_L.RESET;
                  CollectionTax_L.SETRANGE(Fees, CollectionTax_L.Fees::CVO);
                  IF CollectionTax_L.FINDFIRST THEN
                    IF recTax_L.GET(CollectionTax_L.Code, SalesLine_P."VAT Bus. Posting Group") THEN BEGIN
                  // <-- 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                  IF CollectionTax_L.GET(CMCSetup_L."CVO Credit Tax Code") THEN BEGIN
                    // --> 20150825-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-2157-FHS01
                    //BEFORE
                    //TaxUnitPrice_L := CalcCVO(SalesHeader_L."CMC Campaign No.",CMCSetup_L."CVO Credit Tax Code",Item_L) ;
                    //AFTER
                    TaxUnitPrice_L := CalcCVO("CMC Campaign No.", CMCSetup_L."CVO Credit Tax Code", Item_L) ;
                    // <-- 20150825-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-2157-FHS01
                    SalesLine_L.RESET;
                    SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type", "Document Type");
                    SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.", "Document No.");
                    SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("CVO Item Attached Line", "Line No.");
                    IF TaxUnitPrice_L <> 0 THEN BEGIN
                      IF NOT SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                        IF IsAcompteInvoiced(SalesLine_P) THEN BEGIN
                          EXIT;
                        END;
                        InitTaxLine(SalesLine_L,TaxUnitPrice_L,CollectionTax_L."G/L Account","Line No.",'');
                        SalesLine_L.VALIDATE(Description,CollectionTax_L.Description);
                        SalesLine_L.VALIDATE("CVO Item Attached Line", "Line No.");
                        SalesLine_L.INSERT;
                      END;
                      SalesLine_L.VALIDATE("Prepayment VAT Identifier", SalesLine_P."Prepayment VAT Identifier");
                      ModifyTaxLine(SalesLine_L,TaxUnitPrice_L);
                    END ELSE
                      IF SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                        IF NOT(IsAcompteInvoiced(SalesLine_P)) OR (SalesLine_P."Qty. to Ship" <> SalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship") OR
                          (SalesLine_P."Qty. to Invoice" <> SalesLine_L."Qty. to Invoice")
                        THEN BEGIN
                          SalesLine_L.DELETE(TRUE);
                        END;
                      END;
                  END;
                    // --> 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                    END;
                    // <-- 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                END;
                // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                // Generation CVO Corn
                // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                IF Item_L."CVO Corn" THEN BEGIN
                  // --> 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                  CollectionTax_L.RESET;
                  CollectionTax_L.SETRANGE(Fees, CollectionTax_L.Fees::"Corn CVO");
                  IF CollectionTax_L.FINDFIRST THEN
                    IF recTax_L.GET(CollectionTax_L.Code, SalesLine_P."VAT Bus. Posting Group") THEN BEGIN
                  // <-- 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                  IF CollectionTax_L.GET(CMCSetup_L."CVO Corn") THEN BEGIN
                    // --> 20150825-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-2157-FHS01
                    //BEFORE
                    //TaxUnitPrice_L := -CalcCVO(SalesHeader_L."CMC Campaign No.",CMCSetup_L."CVO Corn",Item_L) ; // on redonne la taxe
                    //AFTER
                    TaxUnitPrice_L := -CalcCVO("CMC Campaign No.", CMCSetup_L."CVO Corn", Item_L) ; // on redonne la taxe
                    // <-- 20150825-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-2157-FHS01
                    SalesLine_L.RESET;
                    SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type", "Document Type");
                    SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.", "Document No.");
                    SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("CVO Corn Item Attached Line", "Line No.");
                    IF TaxUnitPrice_L <> 0 THEN BEGIN
                      IF NOT SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                        IF IsAcompteInvoiced(SalesLine_P) THEN BEGIN
                          EXIT;
                        END;
                        InitTaxLine(SalesLine_L,TaxUnitPrice_L,CollectionTax_L."G/L Account","Line No.",'');
                        SalesLine_L.VALIDATE(Description,CollectionTax_L.Description);
                        SalesLine_L.VALIDATE("CVO Corn Item Attached Line", "Line No.");
                        SalesLine_L.INSERT;
                      END;
                      SalesLine_L.VALIDATE("Prepayment VAT Identifier", SalesLine_P."Prepayment VAT Identifier");
                      ModifyTaxLine(SalesLine_L,TaxUnitPrice_L);
                    END ELSE
                      IF SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                        IF NOT(IsAcompteInvoiced(SalesLine_P)) OR (SalesLine_P."Qty. to Ship" <> SalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship") OR
                          (SalesLine_P."Qty. to Invoice" <> SalesLine_L."Qty. to Invoice")
                        THEN BEGIN
                          SalesLine_L.DELETE(TRUE);
                        END;
                      END;
                  END;
                    // --> 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                    END;
                    // <-- 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                END;
                // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                // Generation RPD
                // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                IF CMCSetup_L."Separated RPD" AND (NOT Item_L."No RPD in Sales Line") THEN BEGIN
                  // --> 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                  CollectionTax_L.RESET;
                  CollectionTax_L.SETRANGE(Fees, CollectionTax_L.Fees::RPD);
                  IF CollectionTax_L.FINDFIRST THEN
                    IF recTax_L.GET(CollectionTax_L.Code, SalesLine_P."VAT Bus. Posting Group") THEN BEGIN
                  // <-- 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                    SalesLine_L.RESET;
                    SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type", "Document Type");
                    SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.", "Document No.");
                    SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("RPD Item Attached Line", "Line No.");
                    // calcul de la RPD
                    // --> 20181226-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-38908-FBE
                    //TaxUnitPrice_L := Item_L.CalcUnitPollutionTaxe(WORKDATE,"Location Code","Variant Code");
                    CASE SalesHeader_L."Document Type" OF
                      SalesHeader_L."Document Type"::Order:
                        RpdDate_L:=SalesHeader_L."Order Date";
                      SalesHeader_L."Document Type"::"Return Order":
                        BEGIN
                          RpdDate_L:=SalesHeader_L."Order Date";
                          IF ("Valued From Doc. No." <> '' ) AND RecSalesInvoiceHeader_L.GET("Valued From Doc. No.") THEN
                            RpdDate_L := RecSalesInvoiceHeader_L."Document Date";
                        END;
                      SalesHeader_L."Document Type"::Invoice:
                        RpdDate_L:=SalesHeader_L."Document Date";
                      SalesHeader_L."Document Type"::"Credit Memo":
                        BEGIN
                          RpdDate_L:=SalesHeader_L."Document Date";
                          IF ("Valued From Doc. No." <> '' ) AND RecSalesInvoiceHeader_L.GET("Valued From Doc. No.") THEN
                            RpdDate_L := RecSalesInvoiceHeader_L."Document Date";
                        END;
                    END;
                    IF RpdDate_L=0D THEN
                      RpdDate_L:= WORKDATE;
                    TaxUnitPrice_L := Item_L.CalcUnitPollutionTaxe(RpdDate_L,"Location Code","Variant Code");
                    // <-- 20181226-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-38908-FBE
                    TaxUnitPrice_L := TaxUnitPrice_L * "Qty. per Unit of Measure";
                    IF TaxUnitPrice_L <> 0 THEN BEGIN
                      CMCSetup_L.TESTFIELD(CMCSetup_L."RPD Account");
                      IF NOT SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                        IF IsAcompteInvoiced(SalesLine_P) THEN BEGIN
                          EXIT;
                        END;
                        // --> 20151020-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-2148-CJY01
                        IF SalesLine_P."Quantity Shipped" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
                          EXIT;
                        END;
                        // <-- 20151020-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-2148-CJY01

                        InitTaxLine(SalesLine_L,TaxUnitPrice_L,CMCSetup_L."RPD Account","Line No.",
                                    SalesLine_P."VAT Prod. Posting Group");
                        // --> 20160322-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-1388-DDS01
                        IF "Shipment Location" = '' THEN
                          IF "Document Type" IN ["Document Type"::"Return Order","Document Type"::"Credit Memo"] THEN
                            "Shipment Location" := "Location Code";
                        // <-- 20160322-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-1388-DDS01
                        // --> 20161220-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-1548-DDS01
                        SalesLine_L."Shipment Location" := "Shipment Location";
                        // <-- 20161220-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-1548-DDS01
                        SalesLine_L.VALIDATE("RPD Item Attached Line", "Line No.");
                        SalesLine_L.INSERT;
                      END;
                      GLAcc.GET(SalesLine_L."No.");
                      SalesLine_L.Description := COPYSTR(GLAcc.Name + ' ' + Description,1,50);
                      SalesLine_L.VALIDATE("Prepayment VAT Identifier", SalesLine_P."Prepayment VAT Identifier");
                      ModifyTaxLine(SalesLine_L,TaxUnitPrice_L);
                    END ELSE
                      IF SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                        IF NOT (IsAcompteInvoiced(SalesLine_P)) OR (SalesLine_P."Qty. to Ship" <> SalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship") OR
                          (SalesLine_P."Qty. to Invoice" <> SalesLine_L."Qty. to Invoice")
                        THEN BEGIN
                          SalesLine_L.DELETE(TRUE);
                        END;
                      END;
                    // --> 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                    END;
                    // <-- 20150108-FIN29/001-CMC02.02.00-FHS01
                END;
              END;
            END;
          END;
        END;
        // --> 20120326-Wi00-CMC01.04.05-JLT01
      // --> 20150818-APP21-TER01.01.00-2147-FBE01
      END;
      // <-- 20150818-APP21-TER01.01.00-2147-FBE01
    END;

    PROCEDURE RecalcTaxLine@8053038(SalesHeader_L@8053001 : Record 36);
    VAR
      SalesLine_L@8053000 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20120320-Wi00-CMC01.04.05-JLT01
      // Recalcul des lignes attach'es car en retour, on ne retourne pas en r'ception les taxes
      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader_L."Document Type");
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader_L."No.");
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE(Type,Type::Item);
      IF SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN
        REPEAT
          GenerateTaxLine(SalesLine_L);
        UNTIL SalesLine_L.NEXT=0;
      // <-- 20120320-Wi00-CMC01.04.05-JLT01
    END;

      }

      Salesline_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Invoice (Base)","Qty. to Invoice (Base)");
      // --> 20140923-APP33-CMC02.02.00-FDA01
      Salesline_L.VALIDATE("Customer Price Group", "Customer Price Group");
      // --> 20150318-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2746-FHS01

      Salesline_L.VALIDATE("Prod. Activity Code", "Prod. Activity Code");

      Salesline_L.VALIDATE("Family Code", "Family Code");

      Salesline_L.VALIDATE("Species Code", "Species Code");
      // <-- 20150318-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2746-FHS01
      // <-- 20140923-APP33-CMC02.02.00-FDA01
      Salesline_L."CMC Campaign No." := "CMC Campaign No.";
      Salesline_L.MODIFY;
      // <-- 20120326-Wi00-CMC01.04.05-JLT01
    END;

    PROCEDURE CalcCVO@8053035(campaign_P@8053008 : Code[20];"CVO Credit Tax Code_P"@8053000 : Code[20];Rec_item_p@8053009 : Record 27) UnitPriceCVO_L : Decimal;
    VAR
      CollectionTax_L@8053007 : Record 8053007;
      CollectedTax_L@8053006 : Record 8053006;
      UnitsMeasureCMC_L@8053005 : Record 8053025;
      UnitsMeasureCMC2_L@8053004 : Record 8053025;
      ItemOfUnit_L@8053002 : Record 5404;
      ItemOfUnit2_L@8053001 : Record 5404;
      coeff_l@8053003 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20120326-Wi00-CMC01.04.05-JLT01

      // Recherche du taux de CVO ou du Taux de CVO Corn
      CollectedTax_L.SETRANGE("Campain No.",campaign_P);
      CollectedTax_L.SETRANGE("Species code", '');
      CollectedTax_L.SETFILTER("Starting date", '<=%1', WORKDATE);
      CollectedTax_L.SETRANGE("Tax Code","CVO Credit Tax Code_P");
      IF CollectedTax_L.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
        UnitsMeasureCMC2_L.RESET;
        UnitsMeasureCMC2_L.SETRANGE(Code, CollectedTax_L."Unit Code");
        UnitsMeasureCMC2_L.FINDFIRST;

        UnitsMeasureCMC_L.RESET;
        UnitsMeasureCMC_L.SETRANGE(Code, "Unit of Measure Code");
        IF UnitsMeasureCMC_L.FINDFIRST THEN
          coeff_l := UnitsMeasureCMC_L."Qty. per Unit of Measure" / UnitsMeasureCMC2_L."Qty. per Unit of Measure"
        ELSE BEGIN
          ItemOfUnit_L.RESET;
          ItemOfUnit_L.SETRANGE("Item No.",Rec_item_p."No.");
          ItemOfUnit_L.SETRANGE(Code,CollectedTax_L."Unit Code");
          IF NOT ItemOfUnit_L.FINDFIRST THEN
            ERROR(Text8053000,CollectedTax_L."Unit Code","No.")
          ELSE BEGIN
            ItemOfUnit2_L.RESET;
            ItemOfUnit2_L.SETRANGE("Item No.","No.");
            ItemOfUnit2_L.SETRANGE(Code,"Unit of Measure Code");
            ItemOfUnit2_L.FINDFIRST;
            coeff_l := ItemOfUnit2_L."Qty. per Unit of Measure" / ItemOfUnit_L."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
          END;
        END;
      END;
      UnitPriceCVO_L := -ABS(ROUND(CollectedTax_L."Unit Tax Amount" * coeff_l,0.00001,'='));
      // <-- 20120326-Wi00-CMC01.04.05-JLT01
    END;

    PROCEDURE f_NouveauNo@8053034(line_p@8053002 : Integer) NewLineNo_L : Integer;
    VAR
      SalesLine_L@8053000 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20120326-Wi00-CMC01.04.05-JLT01

      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
      SalesLine_L.SETFILTER("Line No.",'>%1',line_p);
      IF SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN
        NewLineNo_L := ROUND((SalesLine_L."Line No." + line_p) / 2, 1)
      ELSE
        NewLineNo_L := line_p + 10000;
      // <-- 20120326-Wi00-CMC01.04.05-JLT01
    END;

    PROCEDURE ExtractLine@8053011();
    VAR
      SalesLines_L@8053001 : Record 37;
      SalesForTkOut_L@8053000 : Page 8053210;
      "<--3LI Text Constants-->"@8053003 : TextConst;
      Text8053000_L@8053002 : TextConst 'ENU=Order lines which contains item %1 %2 have been found for customer %3.Would you like to see them?;FRA=Des lignes de commandes contenant l''article %1 %2 ont 't' trouv'es pour le client %3.Voulez-vous les afficher?';
      SalesLines2_L@8053004 : Record 37;
      LinkedQuantity_L@8053005 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20111227-Log03-CMC02.01.00-BRA01
      CMCSetup_G.GET;
      IF NOT CMCSetup_G."Display Adduction Line Exist" THEN
        EXIT;

      IF "System Created"  THEN
        EXIT;

      // --> 20170614-LogA07-SCT00.00.00-27830-NED
      //IF (Type = Type::Item) AND Adduction AND (NOT HeaderExtract_G) THEN BEGIN
      IF (Type = Type::Item) AND Adduction AND (NOT HeaderExtract_G) AND NOT IsReserved_G THEN BEGIN
      // <-- 20170614-LogA07-SCT00.00.00-27830-NED
        SalesLines_L.RESET;
        SalesLines_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type",Type,"No.","Variant Code","Drop Shipment","Build Kit","Location Code",
          "Shipment Date");
        SalesLines_L.SETRANGE(SalesLines_L."Document Type",SalesLines_L."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesLines_L.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLines_L.Type::Item);
        SalesLines_L.SETFILTER(SalesLines_L."Sell-to Customer No.","Sell-to Customer No.");
        SalesLines_L.SETFILTER(SalesLines_L."No.","No.");
        SalesLines_L.SETFILTER(SalesLines_L."Variant Code","Variant Code");
        SalesLines_L.SETFILTER(SalesLines_L."Outstanding Quantity",'<>0');
        SalesLines_L.SETRANGE(SalesLines_L."Document Status",SalesLines_L."Document Status"::Released);
        SalesLines_L.SETRANGE("Linked Order No.",'');
        SalesLines_L.SETRANGE("Drop Shipment" ,FALSE);
        IF (SalesLines_L.FINDFIRST) AND GUIALLOWED THEN
          IF CONFIRM(STRSUBSTNO(Text8053000_L,"No.","Variant Code","Sell-to Customer No."),FALSE) THEN BEGIN
            CLEAR(SalesForTkOut_L);
            SalesForTkOut_L.SETTABLEVIEW(SalesLines_L);
            SalesForTkOut_L.LOOKUPMODE := TRUE;
            IF SalesForTkOut_L.RUNMODAL=ACTION::LookupOK THEN BEGIN
              SalesForTkOut_L.GETRECORD(SalesLines_L);
              CheckShipmentWhouseLineExist(SalesLines_L);
              "Linked Order No." := SalesLines_L."Document No.";
              "Linked Order Line No." := SalesLines_L."Line No.";
              "Negotiated Price":=TRUE;
              StatusCheckSuspended := TRUE;
              "Linked Order No." := SalesLines_L."Document No.";
              "Linked Order Line No." := SalesLines_L."Line No.";
              "Salesperson Code" := SalesLines_L."Salesperson Code";
              "Due Date" := SalesLines_L."Due Date";
              "Payment Terms Code" := SalesLines_L."Payment Terms Code";
              IF "Linked Order No." <> '' THEN BEGIN
                LinkedQuantity_L := 0;
                SalesLines2_L.RESET;
                SalesLines2_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type"::Order);
                SalesLines2_L.SETRANGE(Type,Type::Item);
                SalesLines2_L.SETRANGE("No.","No.");
                SalesLines2_L.SETRANGE("Linked Order No.","Linked Order No.");
                IF (SalesLines2_L.FINDSET) AND GUIALLOWED THEN REPEAT
                  LinkedQuantity_L += SalesLines2_L."Outstanding Quantity";
                UNTIL SalesLines2_L.NEXT = 0;
                VALIDATE("Linked Quantity",SalesLines_L."Outstanding Quantity");
                IF LinkedQuantity_L < SalesLines2_L."Linked Quantity" THEN
                  VALIDATE("Linked Quantity","Linked Quantity"-LinkedQuantity_L);
                VALIDATE(Quantity,SalesLines_L."Outstanding Quantity"-LinkedQuantity_L);
                "Linked Quantity" := Quantity;
              END;
              IF Quantity = 0 THEN BEGIN
                "Linked Order No." := '';
                "Linked Order Line No." := 0;
                "Linked Quantity" := 0;
              END;
              VALIDATE("Variant Code",SalesLines_L."Variant Code");
              VALIDATE("Unit Price",SalesLines_L."Unit Price");
              VALIDATE("Line Discount %",SalesLines_L."Line Discount %");
              "Cancel Remaining Qty":=TRUE;
              "Price Anomaly":=SalesLines_L."Price Anomaly";
              "Anomaly Approved" :=SalesLines_L."Anomaly Approved";
            END;
          END;
       END;
      // <-- 20111227-Log03-CMC02.01.00-BRA01
    END;

    PROCEDURE IsLinked@8053013(SalesLine_P@8053000 : Record 37) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SalesLine_L@8053001 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20150619-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2922-FHS01
      EXIT(FALSE);
      // <-- 20150619-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2922-FHS01

      // --> 20120111-Log03-CMC02.01.00-BRA01
      IF (SalesLine_P."Document Type"<>SalesLine_P."Document Type"::Order) OR
         (SalesLine_P.Type<>SalesLine_P.Type::Item)
      THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);
      SalesLine_L.RESET;
      // --> 20150416-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2922-FHS01
      //BEFORE
      //SalesLine_L.SETRANGE(SalesLine_L."Document Type",SalesLine_L."Document Type"::Order);
      //SalesLine_L.SETFILTER(SalesLine_L."Linked Order No.",SalesLine_P."Document No.");
      //SalesLine_L.SETRANGE(SalesLine_L."Linked Order Line No.",SalesLine_P."Line No.");
      //AFTER
      SalesLine_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type", "Document No.", Type, "Linked Order No.");
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type", SalesLine_P."Document Type");
      SalesLine_L.SETFILTER("Document No.", '<>%1', SalesLine_P."Document No.");
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE(Type, SalesLine_P.Type);
      SalesLine_L.SETFILTER("Linked Order No.", SalesLine_P."Document No.");
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Linked Order Line No.", SalesLine_P."Line No.");
      // <-- 20150416-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2922-FHS01
      EXIT(NOT SalesLine_L.ISEMPTY);
      // <-- 20120111-Log03-CMC02.01.00-BRA01
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateDiscountLine@8053018(SalesHeader_P@8053000 : Record 36;DiscountPercent_P@8053004 : Decimal);
    VAR
      SalesLine_L@8053001 : Record 37;
      SalesLineTmp_L@8053002 : TEMPORARY Record 37;
      GeneralPostingSetup_L@8053003 : Record 252;
      LineNo_L@8053005 : Integer;
      AccountPrev_L@8053006 : Code[20];
      NewSalesLine_L@8053007 : Record 37;
      NewPrice_L@8053008 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20120423-Cer11-CMC02.01.00-CER01
      SalesLine_L.RESET;
      SalesLine_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type","Document No.");
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader_P."Document Type");
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader_P."No.");
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Discount Line",TRUE);
      SalesLine_L.DELETEALL(TRUE);

      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine_L.Type::Item);
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Discount Line",FALSE);
      IF SalesLine_L.FINDSET( FALSE , FALSE ) THEN
        REPEAT
          IF SalesLine_L."Line Amount" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
            GeneralPostingSetup_L.GET(SalesLine_L."Gen. Bus. Posting Group",SalesLine_L."Gen. Prod. Posting Group");
            GeneralPostingSetup_L.TESTFIELD("Sales Pmt. Disc. Debit Acc.");
            SalesLineTmp_L.INIT;
            SalesLineTmp_L."Document Type":=SalesLine_L."Document Type";
            SalesLineTmp_L."Document No.":=SalesLine_L."Document No.";
            SalesLineTmp_L."Line No.":=SalesLine_L."Line No.";
            SalesLineTmp_L.VALIDATE(Type,SalesLineTmp_L.Type::"G/L Account");
            SalesLineTmp_L.VALIDATE("No.",GeneralPostingSetup_L."Sales Pmt. Disc. Debit Acc.");
            SalesLineTmp_L.VALIDATE(Quantity,-1);
            SalesLineTmp_L.VALIDATE("Unit Price",DiscountPercent_P * SalesLine_L."Line Amount" / 100 );
            SalesLineTmp_L."Discount Line" := TRUE;
            SalesLineTmp_L.INSERT;
          END;
        UNTIL SalesLine_L.NEXT = 0;

      // On cr'e une seule ligne par compte d'escomte
      SalesLine_L.RESET;
      SalesLine_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type","Document No.");
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader_P."Document Type");
      SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader_P."No.");
      SalesLine_L.FINDLAST;
      LineNo_L := SalesLine_L."Line No." + 10000;
      AccountPrev_L := '';

      SalesLineTmp_L.RESET;
      SalesLineTmp_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type",Type,"No.");
      SalesLineTmp_L.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader_P."Document Type");
      SalesLineTmp_L.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader_P."No.");
      SalesLineTmp_L.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTmp_L.Type::"G/L Account");
      SalesLineTmp_L.SETFILTER("Line No.",'<0');
      IF SalesLineTmp_L.FINDSET( FALSE , FALSE ) THEN
        REPEAT
          IF AccountPrev_L <> SalesLineTmp_L."No." THEN BEGIN
            // On cr'e une nouvelle ligne d'escompte
            NewSalesLine_L := SalesLineTmp_L;
            NewSalesLine_L."Line No." := LineNo_L;
            IF NewSalesLine_L."Unit Price"<>0 THEN BEGIN
              NewSalesLine_L.INSERT;
              LineNo_L := LineNo_L + 10000;
              AccountPrev_L := SalesLineTmp_L."No.";
            END;
          END ELSE BEGIN
            NewPrice_L := NewSalesLine_L."Unit Price" + SalesLineTmp_L."Unit Price";
            NewSalesLine_L.VALIDATE("Unit Price",NewPrice_L);
            IF NewSalesLine_L."Unit Price" = 0 THEN BEGIN
              NewSalesLine_L.DELETE;
              AccountPrev_L:='';
            END ELSE
              NewSalesLine_L.MODIFY;
          END;
        UNTIL SalesLineTmp_L.NEXT = 0;
      // <-- 20120423-Cer11-CMC02.01.00-CER01
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateICAssignment@8053025();
    VAR
      ItemChAssignSales_L@1180250002 : Record 5809;
    BEGIN
      IF "Free Item Root Line" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
        IF ItemChAssignSales_L.GET("Document Type", "Document No.", "Line No.", 10000) THEN BEGIN
          // --> 20160705-APP12-ADV01.01.00-3111-OAN01
          // BEFORE
          {ItemChAssignSales_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Assign", "Qty. to Ship" + "Qty. Shipped Not Invoiced");
          ItemChAssignSales_L.MODIFY;}
          // AFTER
          CASE "Document Type" OF
            "Document Type"::Order:
          ItemChAssignSales_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Assign", "Qty. to Ship" + "Qty. Shipped Not Invoiced");

            "Document Type"::"Return Order":
              ItemChAssignSales_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Assign","Return Qty. to Receive" + "Return Qty. Rcd. Not Invd.");

            "Document Type"::"Credit Memo","Document Type"::Invoice:
              ItemChAssignSales_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Assign","Qty. to Invoice");
          END;
          // <-- 20160705-APP12-ADV01.01.00-3111-OAN01
        END;
      END;
    END;

      // Test d'passement quotas du TC sur affectation contrat d'achat . partir d'une ligne vente
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

      BlanketOrderQuotas_L.RESET;
      BlanketOrderQuotas_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","SalesPerson Code");
      BlanketOrderQuotas_L.SETRANGE("Document No.",PurchBlanketLine_P."Document No.");
      BlanketOrderQuotas_L.SETRANGE("SalesPerson Code",SalesPersonCode_P);
      IF BlanketOrderQuotas_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN

        // Recherche des lignes vente d'ja affect'es sur cette ligne de contrat d'achat pour ce TC

        QtyAlreadyAffect_L := 0;

        SalesLine_L.RESET;
        SalesLine_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Purch. Blanket Order No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Purch. Blanket Order No.",PurchBlanketLine_P."Document No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine_L."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine_L.Type::Item);
        IF SalesLine_L.FINDSET( FALSE , FALSE ) THEN
          REPEAT
           SalesHeader_L.GET(SalesLine_L."Document Type",SalesLine_L."Document No.");
           IF SalesHeader_L."Salesperson Code" = SalesPersonCode_P THEN
             QtyAlreadyAffect_L := QtyAlreadyAffect_L + SalesLine_L.Quantity;
          UNTIL SalesLine_L.NEXT = 0;

        IF ( QtyAlreadyAffect_L + QtyToAffect_P ) > BlanketOrderQuotas_L.Quantity THEN
          ERROR(Text8053018,SalesPersonCode_P);
      END;
      // <-- 20120504-Nut01-CMC02.01.00-CRE01
    END;

    PROCEDURE TestQuotasFromBlanketSalesLine@8053022(PurchBlanketLine_P@8053000 : Record 39;SalesLine_P@8053002 : Record 37);
    VAR
      BlanketOrderQuotas_L@8053001 : Record 8053115;
      SalesLine_L@8053003 : Record 37;
      QtyAlreadyAffect_L@8053004 : Decimal;
      SalesHeader_L@8053005 : Record 36;
      SalesHeader2_L@8053006 : Record 36;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20120504-Nut01-CMC02.01.00-CRE01
      //---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Test d'passement quotas du TC sur affectation contrat d'achat . partir d'une ligne ouverte vente
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

      SalesHeader_L.GET(SalesLine_P."Document Type",SalesLine_P."Document No.");

      BlanketOrderQuotas_L.RESET;
      BlanketOrderQuotas_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","SalesPerson Code");
      BlanketOrderQuotas_L.SETRANGE("Document No.",PurchBlanketLine_P."Document No.");
      BlanketOrderQuotas_L.SETRANGE("SalesPerson Code",SalesHeader_L."Salesperson Code");
      IF BlanketOrderQuotas_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN

        QtyAlreadyAffect_L := 0;

        // Recherche des lignes vente d'ja affect'es sur cette ligne de contrat d'achat pour ce TC

        SalesLine_L.RESET;
        SalesLine_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Purch. Blanket Order No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Purch. Blanket Order No.",PurchBlanketLine_P."Document No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETFILTER("Document Type",'%1|%2',SalesLine_P."Document Type"::Order,
        SalesLine_P."Document Type"::"Blanket Order");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine_L.Type::Item);
        IF SalesLine_L.FINDSET( FALSE , FALSE ) THEN
          REPEAT
            SalesHeader2_L.GET(SalesLine_L."Document Type",SalesLine_L."Document No.");
            IF SalesHeader2_L."Salesperson Code" = SalesHeader_L."Salesperson Code" THEN
              QtyAlreadyAffect_L := QtyAlreadyAffect_L + SalesLine_L.Quantity;
          UNTIL SalesLine_L.NEXT = 0;

        // On ajoute 'galement toute les lignes des commande vente affect'e . la commande ouverte vente

        SalesLine_L.RESET;
        SalesLine_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type","Blanket Order No.","Blanket Order Line No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Blanket Order No.",SalesLine_P."Document No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Blanket Order Line No.",PurchBlanketLine_P."Line No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine_L."Document Type"::Order);
        IF SalesLine_L.FINDSET( FALSE , FALSE ) THEN
          REPEAT
            QtyAlreadyAffect_L := QtyAlreadyAffect_L + SalesLine_L.Quantity;
          UNTIL SalesLine_L.NEXT = 0;

        IF SalesLine_P."Purch. Blanket Order No." <> PurchBlanketLine_P."Document No." THEN
          QtyAlreadyAffect_L+=SalesLine_P.Quantity;

        IF QtyAlreadyAffect_L > BlanketOrderQuotas_L.Quantity THEN
          ERROR(Text8053018,SalesHeader_L."Salesperson Code");
      END;
      // <-- 20120504-Nut01-CMC02.01.00-CRE01
    END;

    PROCEDURE ItemChargeAssignment@8053023(SalesLine_P@8053000 : Record 37);
    VAR
      ItemChargeAssignment_L@8053005 : Record 5809;
      SalesLine_L@8053004 : Record 37;
      NextLineNo_L@8053003 : Integer;
      Currency_L@8053002 : Record 4;
      ItemChargeAssgntSalescdu_L@8053001 : Codeunit 5807;
      SalesHeader_L@8053006 : Record 36;
      QtyToAssign_L@8053007 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20120509-Nut02-CMC02.01.00-CRE01
      CLEAR(ItemChargeAssignment_L);

      ItemChargeAssignment_L.RESET;
      ItemChargeAssignment_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
      ItemChargeAssignment_L.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesLine_P."Document No.");
      ItemChargeAssignment_L.SETRANGE("Document Line No.",SalesLine_P."Line No.");
      IF ItemChargeAssignment_L.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        SalesLine_L.RESET;
        SalesLine_L.GET(SalesLine_P."Document Type",SalesLine_P."Document No.",SalesLine_P."Item Charge Root Line No.");

        ItemChargeAssignment_L.INIT;
        ItemChargeAssignment_L."Document Type" := SalesLine_P."Document Type";
        ItemChargeAssignment_L."Document No." := SalesLine_P."Document No.";
        ItemChargeAssignment_L."Document Line No." := SalesLine_P."Line No.";
        ItemChargeAssignment_L."Line No." := 10000;
        ItemChargeAssignment_L."Item Charge No." := SalesLine_P."No.";
        ItemChargeAssignment_L."Applies-to Doc. Type" := SalesLine_P."Document Type";
        ItemChargeAssignment_L."Applies-to Doc. No." := SalesLine_P."Document No.";
        ItemChargeAssignment_L."Applies-to Doc. Line No." := SalesLine_L."Line No.";
        ItemChargeAssignment_L."Item No." := SalesLine_L."No.";
        ItemChargeAssignment_L.Description := SalesLine_L.Description;

        IF "Currency Code" = '' THEN
          Currency_L.InitRoundingPrecision
        ELSE BEGIN
          SalesHeader_L.GET(SalesLine_P."Document Type",SalesLine_P."Document No.");
          SalesHeader_L.TESTFIELD("Currency Factor");
          Currency_L.GET("Currency Code");
          Currency_L.TESTFIELD("Amount Rounding Precision");
        END;

        ItemChargeAssignment_L."Unit Cost" := SalesLine_P."Unit Price";
        ItemChargeAssignment_L.INSERT;
      END;
      SalesLine_P.CALCFIELDS("Qty. Assigned");
      // --> 20160113-Nut02-ADV01.01.00-2428-JCD01
      IF SalesLine_P."Document Type" IN [SalesLine_P."Document Type"::"Credit Memo",SalesLine_P."Document Type"::"Return Order"] THEN
        QtyToAssign_L := ( SalesLine_P."Return Qty. to Receive" + SalesLine_P."Return Qty. Received" )
           - SalesLine_P."Qty. Assigned"
      ELSE
      // <-- 20160113-Nut02-ADV01.01.00-2428-JCD01
      QtyToAssign_L := ( SalesLine_P."Qty. to Ship" + SalesLine_P."Quantity Shipped" ) - SalesLine_P."Qty. Assigned";
      ItemChargeAssgntSalescdu_L.SuggestAssignment2(SalesLine_P,QtyToAssign_L,1);
      // <-- 20120509-Nut02-CMC02.01.00-CRE01
    END;

    PROCEDURE FindLineLocation@8053004(VAR SalesLine_P@1000000000 : Record 37) : Code[10];
    VAR
      CMCLogisticsPeriod_L@8053006 : Record 8053153;
      CMCActivityLogArea_L@8053005 : Record 8053043;
      CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L@8053007 : Record 8053164;
      Cust_L@8053004 : Record 18;
      Location_L@8053003 : Record 14;
      PeriodFound_L@8053002 : Boolean;
      Item_L@8053001 : Record 27;
      LocationFound_L@8053000 : Boolean;
      SalesSetup_L@8053008 : Record 311;
      ShipToAddress_L@8053009 : Record 222;
      LogisticType_L@8053010 : 'All Location,Location,Logistic Area';
      ScenarioFound_L@8053012 : Boolean;
      SalesLine_L@1000000001 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20111121-APP09-CMC02.01.00-BRA01

      IF (SalesLine_P."Item Mix Root Line No." <> 0) AND
         (SalesLine_L.GET(SalesLine_P."Document Type",SalesLine_P."Document No.",SalesLine_P."Item Mix Root Line No."))
      THEN BEGIN
        SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code",SalesLine_L."Purchasing Code");
        SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Location Code",SalesLine_L."Location Code");
        EXIT;
      END;

      SalesSetup_L.GET;

      GetSalesHeader;
      Cust_L.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");

      IF Cust_L."Location Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
        Location_L.GET(Cust_L."Location Code");
        LocationFound_L := TRUE;
      END;

      IF SalesHeader."Ship-to Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
        // --> 20161122-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3109-JCD01
        {BEFORE
        ShipToAddress_L.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.", SalesHeader."Ship-to Code");
        AFTER}
        IF NOT FromDefalquerSalesLine_G THEN
          ShipToAddress_L.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.", SalesHeader."Ship-to Code")
        ELSE IF NOT ShipToAddress_L.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.", SalesHeader."Ship-to Code") THEN
          CLEAR(ShipToAddress_L);
        // <-- 20161122-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3109-JCD01

        IF ShipToAddress_L."Location Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
          Location_L.GET(ShipToAddress_L."Location Code");
          LocationFound_L := TRUE;
        END;
      END;

      // --> 20150220-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2740-FHS01
      IF SalesHeader."Location Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
        Location_L.GET(SalesHeader."Location Code");
        LocationFound_L := TRUE;
      END;
      // <-- 20150220-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2740-FHS01

      IF NOT LocationFound_L THEN
        IF (SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status" = SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status"::Always) THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code",SalesSetup_L."Drop Shipment Purchasing Code");
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Location Code",SalesSetup_L."Drop Shipment Location Code");
          EXIT;
        END ELSE BEGIN
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code",'');
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Location Code",SalesHeader."Location Code");
          EXIT;
        END;

      Item_L.GET(SalesLine_P."No.");

      IF FindActivLogAreaScenario(Item_L, SalesLine_P, CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L, LogisticType_L::Location, Location_L.Code,
        // --> 20150220-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2740-FHS01
        //BEFORE
        //Location_L."Logistic Area Code", SalesHeader."Shipment Method Code")
        //AFTER
        Location_L."Logistic Area Code", SalesLine_P."Shipment Method Code")
        // <-- 20150220-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2740-FHS01
      THEN
        ScenarioFound_L := TRUE
      ELSE
        IF FindActivLogAreaScenario(Item_L, SalesLine_P, CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L, LogisticType_L::"Logistic Area", Location_L.Code,
          // --> 20150220-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2740-FHS01
          //BEFORE
          //Location_L."Logistic Area Code", SalesHeader."Shipment Method Code")
          //AFTER
          Location_L."Logistic Area Code", SalesLine_P."Shipment Method Code")
          // <-- 20150220-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2740-FHS01
        THEN
          ScenarioFound_L := TRUE
        ELSE
          IF FindActivLogAreaScenario(Item_L, SalesLine_P, CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L, LogisticType_L::"All Location", Location_L.Code,
            // --> 20150220-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2740-FHS01
            //BEFORE
            //Location_L."Logistic Area Code", SalesHeader."Shipment Method Code")
            //AFTER
            Location_L."Logistic Area Code", SalesLine_P."Shipment Method Code")
            // <-- 20150220-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2740-FHS01
          THEN
            ScenarioFound_L := TRUE;

      IF ScenarioFound_L THEN BEGIN
        IF (SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status" = SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status"::" ") OR
           ((SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status" = SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status"::Never) AND
           (NOT CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L."Drop Shipment"))
        THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code", CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L."Purchasing Code");
          IF CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L."Purchasing Flexibility" = CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L."Purchasing Flexibility"::Unlimited THEN
            SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Flexibility", SalesLine_P."Purchasing Flexibility"::Unlimited)
          ELSE
            IF CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L."Purchasing Flexibility" = CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L."Purchasing Flexibility"::None THEN
              SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Flexibility",SalesLine_P."Purchasing Flexibility"::"None (Logistic)");
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Location Code",CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L."Location Code");
          EXIT;
        END;

        IF (SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status" = SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status"::Never) AND
          (CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L."Drop Shipment")
        THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Flexibility", SalesLine_P."Purchasing Flexibility"::Unlimited);
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code", '');
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Location Code",'');
          EXIT;
        END;

        IF (SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status" = SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status"::Always) THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Flexibility", SalesLine_P."Purchasing Flexibility"::"None (Item)");
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code",SalesSetup_L."Drop Shipment Purchasing Code");
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Location Code",SalesSetup_L."Drop Shipment Location Code");
          EXIT;
        END;

        InitPurchFlexibilityAdduction(SalesLine_P);
      END ELSE // no scenario was found
        IF (SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status" = SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status"::Always) THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Flexibility", SalesLine_P."Purchasing Flexibility"::"None (Item)");
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code",SalesSetup_L."Drop Shipment Purchasing Code");
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Location Code",SalesSetup_L."Drop Shipment Location Code");
          EXIT;

          InitPurchFlexibilityAdduction(SalesLine_P);
        // --> 20210207-WI00-ADV01.01.00-CC8005-CJY01
        {BEFORE
        END ELSE
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code",'');
        AFTER}
        END ELSE BEGIN
          SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code",'');
          IF SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status" = SalesLine_P."Drop Shipment Status"::Always THEN
            SalesLine_P."Purchasing Flexibility" := SalesLine_P."Purchasing Flexibility"::"None (Item)"
          ELSE
            SalesLine_P."Purchasing Flexibility" := SalesLine_P."Purchasing Flexibility"::Unlimited;

        END;
        // <-- 20210207-WI00-ADV01.01.00-CC8005-CJY01
      SalesLine_P.VALIDATE("Location Code",SalesHeader."Location Code");
      // <-- 20111121-APP09-CMC02.01.00-BRA01
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateFreeProLineFromAdduction@1000000005();
    VAR
      SalesLines2_L@1000000000 : Record 37;
      SalesLines3_L@1000000001 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Entr'es:
      //   - sur le Rec

      //   -

          SalesLines3_L.FINDFIRST;
          SalesLines3_L.VALIDATE(Quantity,SalesLines2_L."Outstanding Quantity");
          SalesLines3_L.MODIFY;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE FillSeason@8053028() : Boolean;
    VAR
      Season_L@8053000 : Record 8053154;
      TmpSeason_L@8053001 : TEMPORARY Record 8053154;
      SeasonLevel_L@1000000000 : Integer;
      TableauType_L@1000000001 : ARRAY [6] OF Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF (SeasonIsFilled_G = FALSE) OR (UpdateFromHeader_G) THEN
        SeasonIsFilled_G := TRUE
      ELSE
        EXIT(TRUE);

      TmpSeason_L.RESET;
      TmpSeason_L.DELETEALL;

      CampaignMgt_G.GetAvailableSeason(TmpSeason_L,Rec);

      // --> 20160623-APP17-ADV01.01.00-3093-OAN01
      // BEFORE
      {IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT > 1 THEN BEGIN
        IF "Season ID No." <> 0 THEN BEGIN
          TmpSeason_L.SETRANGE("ID No.","Season ID No.");
          IF TmpSeason_L.ISEMPTY THEN
            VALIDATE("Season ID No.", 0);
        END;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT  = 1 THEN BEGIN
        TmpSeason_L.FINDFIRST;
        VALIDATE("Season ID No.", TmpSeason_L."ID No.");
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;}
      // AFTER
      IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT = 1 THEN BEGIN
        // Only One Season
        TmpSeason_L.FINDFIRST;
        VALIDATE("Season ID No.", TmpSeason_L."ID No.");
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;


      // --> 20230322-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3614-CJY01
      {BEFORE
      IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT > 1 THEN BEGIN
        // More Than One Season
        FOR SeasonLevel_L := 5 DOWNTO 1 DO BEGIN
          TmpSeason_L.SETRANGE(Type,SeasonLevel_L-1);
          IF TmpSeason_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT = 1 THEN BEGIN
              VALIDATE("Season ID No.", TmpSeason_L."ID No.");
              EXIT(TRUE);
            END ELSE BEGIN
              TmpSeason_L.SETFILTER("Campaign No.",'<>%1',TmpSeason_L."Campaign No.");
              IF NOT TmpSeason_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                TmpSeason_L.SETRANGE("Campaign No.");
                TmpSeason_L.FINDLAST;
                VALIDATE("Season ID No.", TmpSeason_L."ID No.");
                EXIT(TRUE);
              END;
      END;
      AFTER}
      TableauType_L[6] := 4;
      TableauType_L[5] := 5;
      TableauType_L[4] := 3;
      TableauType_L[3] := 2;
      TableauType_L[2] := 1;
      TableauType_L[1] := 0;

      IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT > 1 THEN BEGIN
        // More Than One Season
        FOR SeasonLevel_L := 6 DOWNTO 1 DO BEGIN
          TmpSeason_L.SETRANGE(Type,TableauType_L[SeasonLevel_L]);
          IF TmpSeason_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT = 1 THEN BEGIN
              VALIDATE("Season ID No.", TmpSeason_L."ID No.");
              EXIT(TRUE);
            END ELSE BEGIN
              TmpSeason_L.SETFILTER("Campaign No.",'<>%1',TmpSeason_L."Campaign No.");
              IF NOT TmpSeason_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                TmpSeason_L.SETRANGE("Campaign No.");
                TmpSeason_L.FINDLAST;
                VALIDATE("Season ID No.", TmpSeason_L."ID No.");
                EXIT(TRUE);
              END;
      END;

      // <-- 20230322-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3614-CJY01
      END;
        END;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;
      // <-- 20160623-APP17-ADV01.01.00-3093-OAN01
    END;

    PROCEDURE FillFromItemSalesNetwork@8053030(SellToCustomerNo@8053001 : Code[20]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ItemSalesNetwork_L@8053000 : Record 8053162;
    BEGIN
      //------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      //Fills automatically "Prod. Activity Code" and "Sales Network Code" from Item Sales Network
      //  searching the most accurate setup: item and variant/item/species/subfamily/family/activity
      // Input:
      //   - SellToCustomerNo from Sales Header
      //   - the modifications are made on Rec
      // Output:
      //   - boolean - returns TRUE when a setup was found
      //------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // --> 20130402-Gen06-CMC02.02.00-MMI
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.RESET;

      //Search by Item and Variant Code
      IF "Variant Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
        ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE(Type, ItemSalesNetwork_L.Type::Item);
        ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("No.", "No.");
        ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("Item Variant", "Variant Code");
        IF SellToCustomerNo <> '' THEN
          ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("Customer No.",SellToCustomerNo);

        IF ItemSalesNetwork_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          VALIDATE("Prod. Activity Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Prod. Activity Code");
          VALIDATE("Sales Network Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Sales Network Code");
          EXIT(TRUE);
        END;
      END;

      //Search by Item
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE(Type, ItemSalesNetwork_L.Type::Item);
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("No.", "No.");
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("Item Variant");
      IF SellToCustomerNo <> '' THEN
        ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("Customer No.",SellToCustomerNo);
      IF ItemSalesNetwork_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        VALIDATE("Prod. Activity Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Prod. Activity Code");
        VALIDATE("Sales Network Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Sales Network Code");
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      //Search by Species
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE(Type, ItemSalesNetwork_L.Type::Species);
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("No.", "Species Code");
      IF SellToCustomerNo <> '' THEN
        ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("Customer No.",SellToCustomerNo);
      IF ItemSalesNetwork_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        VALIDATE("Prod. Activity Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Prod. Activity Code");
        VALIDATE("Sales Network Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Sales Network Code");
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      //Search by Subfamily
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE(Type, ItemSalesNetwork_L.Type::Subfamily);
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("No.", "Sub-Family Code");
      IF SellToCustomerNo <> '' THEN
        ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("Customer No.",SellToCustomerNo);
      IF ItemSalesNetwork_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        VALIDATE("Prod. Activity Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Prod. Activity Code");
        VALIDATE("Sales Network Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Sales Network Code");
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      //Search by Family
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE(Type, ItemSalesNetwork_L.Type::Family);
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("No.", "Family Code");
      IF SellToCustomerNo <> '' THEN
        ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("Customer No.",SellToCustomerNo);
      IF ItemSalesNetwork_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        VALIDATE("Prod. Activity Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Prod. Activity Code");
        VALIDATE("Sales Network Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Sales Network Code");
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      //Search by Activity
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE(Type, ItemSalesNetwork_L.Type::Activity);
      ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("No.", "Activity Code");
      // --> 20130508-Gen06-CMC02.02.00-BSI01
      IF SellToCustomerNo <> '' THEN
        ItemSalesNetwork_L.SETRANGE("Customer No.",SellToCustomerNo);
      IF ItemSalesNetwork_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        VALIDATE("Prod. Activity Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Prod. Activity Code");
        VALIDATE("Sales Network Code", ItemSalesNetwork_L."Sales Network Code");
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      EXIT(FALSE);
      // <-- 20130402-Gen06-CMC02.02.00-MMI
    END;

    PROCEDURE InitPurchFlexibilityAdduction@8053031(VAR SalesLine_P@8053000 : Record 37);
    VAR
      SalesSetup_L@8053001 : Record 311;
