      // <-- 20130425-Log05-CMC02.02.00-MMI01
    END;

    PROCEDURE FindActivLogAreaScenario@8053032(Item_P@8053006 : Record 27;SalesLine_P@8053007 : Record 37;VAR CMCActivLogAreaScenario_P@8053011 : Record 8053164;LogisticType_P@8053005 : 'All Location,Location,Logistic Area';LocationCode_P@8053004 : Code[20];ZoneLogistique_P@8053002 : Code[20];ShipmentMethodCode_P@8053000 : Code[20]) ScenarioFound : Boolean;
    VAR
      CMCActivityLogArea_L@8053003 : Record 8053043;
      CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L@8053008 : Record 8053164;
      CMCLogisticsPeriod_L@8053009 : Record 8053153;
      PeriodFound_L@8053010 : Boolean;
      UserSetup_L@1000000000 : Record 91;
      InventorySetup_L@1000000001 : Record 313;
    BEGIN
      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // The function looks for the right activity logistic scenario to use
      // Input:
      //   - Item_P : item record from Sales Line
      //   - SalesLine_P - the record Sales Line on which the modification is made
      //   - CMCActivLogAreaScenario_P - the scenario that is found
      //   - LogisticType_P - Logistic Type of the location
      //   - LocationCode_P - Location Code
      //   - ZoneLogistique_P - set if the search is done by Location, Zone Logistic or All Location
      //   - ShipmentMethodCode_P - Shipment Method Code og the header
      // Output:
      //   - ScenarioFound - TRUE is a scenario is found
      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // --> 20130425-Log05-CMC02.02.00-MMI01

      CMCActivityLogArea_L.RESET;
      // --> 20180801-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3353-CJY01
      InventorySetup_L.GET;
      IF InventorySetup_L."User Group in Log. Act." THEN BEGIN
        UserSetup_L.GET(USERID);
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETFILTER("Filtre Code Groupe Utilisateur",UserSetup_L."User Groupe Code");
      END;

      // <-- 20180801-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3353-CJY01

      CASE LogisticType_P OF
        LogisticType_P::"All Location" :
          BEGIN
            CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE("Logistic Type", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Logistic Type"::"All Location");
            CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE(Code);
          END;
        LogisticType_P::Location :
          BEGIN
            CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE("Logistic Type", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Logistic Type"::Location);
            CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETFILTER(Code,'%1|%2',LocationCode_P,'');
          END;
        LogisticType_P::"Logistic Area" :
          BEGIN
            CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE("Logistic Type", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Logistic Type"::"Logistic Area");
            CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETFILTER(Code,'%1|%2',ZoneLogistique_P,'');
          END;
      END;

      IF ShipmentMethodCode_P <> '' THEN
       CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETFILTER("Shipment Method Code", '%1|%2', ShipmentMethodCode_P, '');
      IF Item_P."Packaging Type" <> '' THEN
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETFILTER("Packing Type Code", '%1|%2', Item_P."Packaging Type", '');
      CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE(CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type,CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type::Item);
      CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE(CMCActivityLogArea_L."No.",SalesLine_P."No.");
      IF (SalesLine_P."Variant Code" <> '') THEN
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE(CMCActivityLogArea_L."Item Variant Code", SalesLine_P."Variant Code");
      IF (NOT CMCActivityLogArea_L.FINDLAST) THEN
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE(CMCActivityLogArea_L."Item Variant Code");
      IF (NOT CMCActivityLogArea_L.FINDLAST) AND (Item_P."Species Code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE(CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type,CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type::Species);
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETFILTER(CMCActivityLogArea_L."No.",Item_P."Species Code");
      END;
      IF (NOT CMCActivityLogArea_L.FINDLAST) AND (Item_P."Sub-Family Code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE(CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type,CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type::Subfamily);
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETFILTER(CMCActivityLogArea_L."No.",Item_P."Sub-Family Code");
      END;
      IF (NOT CMCActivityLogArea_L.FINDLAST) AND (Item_P."Family Code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE(CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type,CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type::Family);
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETFILTER(CMCActivityLogArea_L."No.",Item_P."Family Code");
      END;
      IF (NOT CMCActivityLogArea_L.FINDLAST) AND (Item_P."Activity Code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETRANGE(CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type,CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type::Activity);
        CMCActivityLogArea_L.SETFILTER(CMCActivityLogArea_L."No.",Item_P."Activity Code");
      END;

      IF CMCActivityLogArea_L.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
        IF CMCActivityLogArea_L.Apply = CMCActivityLogArea_L.Apply::"Active Scenario" THEN BEGIN
          CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.RESET;
          CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("Logistic Type", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Logistic Type");
          CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE(Code, CMCActivityLogArea_L.Code);
          CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE(Type, CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type);
          CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("No.", CMCActivityLogArea_L."No.");
          CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Item Variant Code");
          CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("Shipment Method Code", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Shipment Method Code");
          CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("Packing Type Code", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Packing Type Code");
          CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("Logistic Scenario Code", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Active Logist. Scenario Code");
          IF CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            CMCActivLogAreaScenario_P := CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L;
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END;
        END ELSE
          IF CMCActivityLogArea_L.Apply = CMCActivityLogArea_L.Apply::"Logistic Period Scenario" THEN BEGIN
            CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.RESET;
            CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETRANGE("Logistic Type", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Logistic Type");
            CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETFILTER(Code,'%1|%2', CMCActivityLogArea_L.Code, '');
            CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETRANGE(Type,CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.Type::Item);
            CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETFILTER("No.",SalesLine_P."No.");
            CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETFILTER("Starting Date",'<=%1|=%2',SalesHeader."Order Date",0D);
            CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETFILTER("Ending Date",'>=%1|=%2',SalesHeader."Order Date",0D);
            IF (SalesLine_P."Variant Code" <> '') THEN
              CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code", SalesLine_P."Variant Code");
            PeriodFound_L := CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.FINDLAST;
            IF (NOT PeriodFound_L)  THEN BEGIN
              CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code");
              PeriodFound_L := CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.FINDLAST;
            END;
            IF (NOT PeriodFound_L) AND (Item_P."Species Code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
              CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETRANGE(Type, CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.Type::Species);
              CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETFILTER("No.", Item_P."Species Code");
              PeriodFound_L := CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.FINDLAST;
            END;
            IF (NOT PeriodFound_L) AND (Item_P."Sub-Family Code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
              CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETRANGE(Type, CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.Type::Subfamily);
              CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETFILTER("No.", Item_P."Sub-Family Code");
              PeriodFound_L := CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.FINDLAST;
            END;
            IF (NOT PeriodFound_L) AND (Item_P."Family Code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
              CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETRANGE(Type, CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.Type::Family);
              CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETFILTER("No.", Item_P."Family Code");
              PeriodFound_L := CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.FINDLAST;
            END;
            IF (NOT PeriodFound_L) AND (SalesLine_P."Activity Code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
              CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETRANGE(Type, CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.Type::Activity);
              CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.SETFILTER("No.", SalesLine_P."Activity Code");
              PeriodFound_L := CMCLogisticsPeriod_L.FINDLAST;
            END;

            IF PeriodFound_L THEN BEGIN
              CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.RESET;
              CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("Logistic Type", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Logistic Type");
              CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE(Code, CMCActivityLogArea_L.Code);
              CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE(Type, CMCActivityLogArea_L.Type);
              CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("No.", CMCActivityLogArea_L."No.");
              CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Item Variant Code");
              CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("Shipment Method Code", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Shipment Method Code");
              CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("Packing Type Code", CMCActivityLogArea_L."Packing Type Code");
              CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.SETRANGE("Logistic Scenario Code", CMCLogisticsPeriod_L."Logistic Scenario Code");
              IF CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                CMCActivLogAreaScenario_P := CMCActivLogAreaScenario_L;
                EXIT(TRUE);
              END;
            END;
          END;
      END;

      EXIT(FALSE);
      // <-- 20130425-Log05-CMC02.02.00-MMI01
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetCustomerPriceGroup@8053051(ItemNo_P@8053000 : Code[20]) : Code[10];
    VAR
      CMCCustomerPriceGroup@8053001 : Record 8053172;
      i@8053002 : Integer;
      Item_L@8053007 : Record 27;
    BEGIN
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Get Customer Price Group
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Input: - Item No., Species, Subfamily, Famyly, Activity
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // --> 20130425-APP19-CMC02.02.00-PPE01
      Item_L.GET(ItemNo_P);
      CMCCustomerPriceGroup.SETRANGE("Campaign No.","CMC Campaign No.");
      CMCCustomerPriceGroup.SETRANGE("Customer No.", "Sell-to Customer No.");
      FOR i := 4 DOWNTO 0 DO BEGIN
        CMCCustomerPriceGroup.SETRANGE(Type, i);
        CASE i OF
          4 : CMCCustomerPriceGroup.SETRANGE(Code, ItemNo_P);
          3 : CMCCustomerPriceGroup.SETRANGE(Code, Item_L."Species Code");
          2 : CMCCustomerPriceGroup.SETRANGE(Code, Item_L."Sub-Family Code");
          1 : CMCCustomerPriceGroup.SETRANGE(Code, Item_L."Family Code");
          0 : CMCCustomerPriceGroup.SETRANGE(Code, Item_L."Activity Code");
        END;
        IF CMCCustomerPriceGroup.FINDFIRST THEN
          EXIT(CMCCustomerPriceGroup."Customer Price Group");
      END;

      EXIT('');
      // <-- 20130425-APP19-CMC02.02.00-PPE01
    END;

    PROCEDURE SetUnitPriceFromContract@8053043(VAR SalesLine_P@8053005 : Record 37) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SalesPriceCalcMgt_L@8053000 : Codeunit 7000;
      ReferenceDate_L@8053001 : Date;
      CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L@8053002 : Record 8053170;
      SalesHeader_L@8053003 : Record 36;
      DateCaption_L@8053004 : Text[30];
      CMCSetup_L@8053006 : Record 8052982;
      SalesBanketOrderLine_L@8053007 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // INPUT/OUTPUT : table 37 - Sales Line
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Set Unit Price from contract if exists one
      // Apply tolerance value to Unit Price
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // --> 20130425-APP19-CMC02.02.00-PPE01

      // --> 20150429-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2962-FHS01
      //BEFORE
      //IF (SalesLine_P."Blanket Order No." = '') AND (SalesLine_P."Blanket Order Line No." = 0) THEN
      //AFTER
      IF (SalesLine_P."Blanket Order No." = '') OR (SalesLine_P."Blanket Order Line No." = 0) THEN
      // <-- 20150429-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2962-FHS01    ***
        EXIT(FALSE);

      SalesHeader_L.GET(SalesLine_P."Document Type", SalesLine_P."Document No.");
      ReferenceDate_L := SalesPriceCalcMgt_L.GetReferenceDate(SalesHeader_L, SalesLine_P, DateCaption_L);

      CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L.SETRANGE("Sales/Purchase", CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L."Sales/Purchase"::Sales);
      CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L.SETRANGE("Line Type", CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L."Line Type"::Both);
      CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L.SETRANGE("Blanket Order No.", SalesLine_P."Blanket Order No.");
      CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L.SETRANGE("Blanket Order Line No.", SalesLine_P."Blanket Order Line No.");

      IF NOT SalesLine_P."In Blanket Ord. Tol. Per." THEN BEGIN
        CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L.SETFILTER("Starting Date", '<=%1', ReferenceDate_L);
        CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L.SETFILTER("Ending Date", '>=%1', ReferenceDate_L);
        IF CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine_P."Unit Price" := CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L."Price/Cost";
          SalesLine_P."Price Anomaly" := FALSE;
          SalesLine_P."Price Anomaly Type" := 0;
          EXIT(TRUE);
        END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        CMCSetup_L.GET;
        CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L.SETFILTER("Starting Date", '<=%1', CALCDATE(FORMAT(CMCSetup_L."Sales Blank. Ord Date Tol Per"),
        ReferenceDate_L));
        CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L.SETFILTER("Ending Date",'>=%1',CALCDATE('-' + FORMAT(CMCSetup_L."Sales Blank. Ord Date Tol Per"),
          ReferenceDate_L));
        IF CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          CASE CMCSetup_L."Sales Bl. Ord. Tol. Incr. Type" OF
            CMCSetup_L."Sales Bl. Ord. Tol. Incr. Type"::Percent :
              SalesLine_P."Unit Price" := CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L."Price/Cost" +
                CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L."Price/Cost" * CMCSetup_L."Sales Bl. Ord. Tol. Incr Value"/100;
            CMCSetup_L."Sales Bl. Ord. Tol. Incr. Type"::Amount :
              SalesLine_P."Unit Price" := CMCBlanketOrderDetail_L."Price/Cost" + CMCSetup_L."Sales Bl. Ord. Tol. Incr Value";
          END;
          SalesLine_P."Price Anomaly" := FALSE;
          SalesLine_P."Price Anomaly Type" := 0;
          EXIT(TRUE);
        END;
      END;

      //Cas des lignes de contrat sans d'tail
      IF SalesBanketOrderLine_L.GET("Document Type"::"Blanket Order",SalesLine_P."Blanket Order No.",SalesLine_P.
      "Blanket Order Line No.")
      THEN BEGIN
        SalesLine_P."Unit Price" := SalesBanketOrderLine_L."Unit Price";
        SalesLine_P."Price Anomaly" := FALSE;
        SalesLine_P."Price Anomaly Type" := 0;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      EXIT(FALSE);
      // <-- 20130425-APP19-CMC02.02.00-PPE01
    END;

    PROCEDURE RestrictModifyItemMixLines@8053033(RestrictOnlyAdditiveLines@8053000 : Boolean);
    BEGIN
      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateFieldsForItemMixes@8053044(ChangedFieldName@8053003 : Text[100]);
    VAR
      SalesLine_L@8053001 : Record 37;
      SalesLine2_L@1000000000 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // The function updates the lines of additive when a field is changed in the root line of the mixture
      // Input:  - current Sales Line
      //         - name of the field that was modified
      // Output: -
      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // --> 20130605-Nut04-CMC02.02.00-BSI01
      IF "Item Mix Root Line No." = 0 THEN
        EXIT;

      IF "Item Mix Root Line No." = "Line No." THEN BEGIN //root item mix line
        SalesLine_L.RESET;
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Item Mix Root Line No.","Item Mix Root Line No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETFILTER("Line No.",'<>%1',"Item Mix Root Line No.");
        IF SalesLine_L.FINDSET THEN
          REPEAT
            SalesLine2_L.GET(SalesLine_L."Document Type",SalesLine_L."Document No.",SalesLine_L."Line No.");
            CASE ChangedFieldName OF
              FIELDCAPTION("Location Code") :
                SalesLine2_L.VALIDATE("Location Code","Location Code");
              FIELDCAPTION("Purchasing Code") :
                SalesLine2_L.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code","Purchasing Code");
              FIELDCAPTION("Drop Shipment") :
                SalesLine2_L.VALIDATE("Drop Shipment","Drop Shipment");
              FIELDCAPTION("Special Order") :
                SalesLine2_L.VALIDATE("Special Order","Special Order");
              FIELDCAPTION("Shipment Method Code"):
                SalesLine2_L.VALIDATE("Shipment Method Code","Shipment Method Code");
              FIELDCAPTION("Delivery Method Code") :
                SalesLine2_L.VALIDATE("Delivery Method Code","Delivery Method Code");
              FIELDCAPTION("Ship-to Code") :
                SalesLine2_L.VALIDATE("Ship-to Code","Ship-to Code");
              FIELDCAPTION("CMC Campaign No.") :
                SalesLine2_L.VALIDATE("CMC Campaign No.","CMC Campaign No.");
              FIELDCAPTION("Salesperson Code") :
                SalesLine2_L.VALIDATE("Salesperson Code","Salesperson Code");
              FIELDCAPTION("Due Date") :
                SalesLine2_L.VALIDATE("Due Date","Due Date");
              FIELDCAPTION("Cancel Remaining Qty") :
                SalesLine2_L.VALIDATE("Cancel Remaining Qty","Cancel Remaining Qty");
            END;
            SalesLine2_L.MODIFY(TRUE);
          UNTIL SalesLine_L.NEXT = 0;
      END;
      // <-- 20130605-Nut04-CMC02.02.00-BSI01
    END;

    PROCEDURE DeleteDropShipPurchLine@8060983(SalesLine_P@8060982 : Record 37);
    VAR

      PurchaseLine2_L@8060983 : Record 39;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20130617-8060990/104-CMB6.00.10.09-FDA01
      WITH SalesLine_P DO BEGIN

          IF PurchaseLine_L.GET(PurchaseLine_L."Document Type"::Order,"Purchase Order No.","Purch. Order Line No.") THEN BEGIN

            PurchaseLine_L.SetAllowChangeDeletion(TRUE);
            PurchaseLine_L.DELETE(TRUE);
            PurchaseLine_L.SuspendStatusCheck(FALSE);
            PurchaseLine_L.SetAllowChangeDeletion(FALSE);
            // --> 20171005-WI00-ADV01.01.00-29507-CJY01
            IF NOT SilentLd_G THEN
            // <-- 20171005-WI00-ADV01.01.00-29507-CJY01

            PurchaseLine2_L.RESET;

            //REPLACE

            //PurchaseLine2_L.SETFILTER("Line No.",'<>%1',"Purch. Order Line No.");
            //BY
            PurchaseLine2_L.SETRANGE("Document No.","Purchase Order No.");

            IF PurchaseLine2_L.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
              IF PurchaseHeader_L.GET(PurchaseHeader_L."Document Type"::Order,"Purchase Order No.") THEN BEGIN
                // --> 20171005-WI00-ADV01.01.00-29507-CJY01

                PurchaseHeader_L.DELETE(TRUE);
                AFTER}

                  PurchaseHeader_L.FctSilentSoldeReliquat(TRUE);
                IF PurchaseHeader_L.DELETE(TRUE) THEN;

                // <-- 20171005-WI00-ADV01.01.00-29507-CJY01

            END;
          END;
        END ELSE
          EXIT;
      END;
      // <-- 20130617-8060990/104-CMB6.00.10.09-FDA01
    END;

    PROCEDURE SetCDC@8053045();
    VAR
      CMCSpecificationMCThird_L@8053002 : Record 8053218;
      CMCMCCompany_L@8053001 : Record 8053075;
      CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L@8053000 : Record 8053076;
      CMCSpecificationMCItem_L@8053003 : Record 8053216;
      CMCSpecificationMCLocation_L@8053006 : Record 8053217;
      OptionType_L@8053004 : Integer;
      AuthorizedItem_L@8053005 : Boolean;
      Item_L@8053007 : Record 27;
      Location_L@8053008 : Record 14;
      SalesHeader_L@8053009 : Record 36;
      IsAuthorized_L@1000000000 : Boolean;
      IsForbidden_L@1000000001 : Boolean;
      SetupFound_L@1000000002 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Set Specification Code field
      // Input: -
      // Output: -
      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // --> 20130614-NUT06-CMC02.02.00-PPE01
      IF (Type <> Type::Item) OR ("Document Type" <> "Document Type"::Order) THEN
        EXIT;

      CMCMCCompany_L.SETRANGE("Company Name", COMPANYNAME);
      IF CMCMCCompany_L.FINDFIRST THEN;
      IF NOT CMCMCCompany_L."Active MC Third Party" THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L.GET(CMCMCCompany_L.Code, CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L.Type::Item, "No.") THEN
        EXIT;

      Item_L.GET(CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L."No.");

      GetSalesHeader;
      CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Contact code");
      CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L.SETRANGE("MC Company Code",CMCMCCompany_L.Code);
      CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L.SETRANGE(Type,CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L.Type::"Third party");
      //Le N› contact et le N› client portent le m^me N›
      CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L.SETRANGE("Contact code",SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
      CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L.FINDFIRST;

      CMCSpecificationMCThird_L.SETRANGE("MC Third Code",CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L."No.");
      IF CMCSpecificationMCThird_L.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.SETRANGE("Specification Code", CMCSpecificationMCThird_L."Specification Code");
          IsAuthorized_L := FALSE;
          IsForbidden_L := FALSE;
          SetupFound_L := FALSE;
          FOR OptionType_L := 0 TO 4 DO BEGIN
            CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.SETRANGE(Type, OptionType_L);
            CASE OptionType_L OF
              0 :
                CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.SETRANGE(Code, Item_L."Activity Code");
              1 :
                CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.SETRANGE(Code, Item_L."Family Code");
              2 :
                CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.SETRANGE(Code, Item_L."Sub-Family Code");
              3 :
                CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.SETRANGE(Code, Item_L."Species Code");
              4 :
                BEGIN
                  IF "Variant Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
                    CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.SETRANGE(Code, Item_L."No.");
                    CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.SETRANGE("Variant code", "Variant Code");
                    IF NOT CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.FINDFIRST THEN
                      CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.SETRANGE("Variant code");
                  END ELSE
                    CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.SETRANGE(Code, Item_L."No.");
                END;
            END;
            IF CMCSpecificationMCItem_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
              SetupFound_L := TRUE;
              IF CMCSpecificationMCItem_L."Control Type" = CMCSpecificationMCItem_L."Control Type"::Forbid THEN
                IsForbidden_L := TRUE;
              IF CMCSpecificationMCItem_L."Control Type" = CMCSpecificationMCItem_L."Control Type"::Authorize THEN BEGIN
                IsAuthorized_L := TRUE;
                "Specification Code" := CMCSpecificationMCThird_L."Specification Code";
                VALIDATE("Location Code", CMCSpecificationMCItem_L."Location Code");
                VALIDATE("Purchasing Code", '');
                IF "Location Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
                  IF NOT CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L.GET(CMCMCCompany_L.Code, CMCMCMasterdataRelation_L.Type::Location,"Location Code")
                  THEN
                    ERROR(Text8053075,"Location Code");
                  CMCSpecificationMCLocation_L.RESET;
                  CMCSpecificationMCLocation_L.SETRANGE("Specification Code", CMCSpecificationMCThird_L."Specification Code");
                  IF CMCSpecificationMCLocation_L.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
                    CMCSpecificationMCLocation_L.SETRANGE("MC Location Code", "Location Code");
                    IF NOT CMCSpecificationMCLocation_L.FINDFIRST THEN
                      ERROR(Text8053030);
                  END;
                END;
              END;
            END;
          END;
          IF SetupFound_L = FALSE THEN
            IsAuthorized_L := TRUE;
        UNTIL (CMCSpecificationMCThird_L.NEXT = 0) OR (NOT IsAuthorized_L AND IsForbidden_L);

        IF NOT IsAuthorized_L AND IsForbidden_L THEN
          ERROR(Text8053029);
      END;
      // <-- 20130626-NUT06-CMC02.02.00-MMI01
    END;

    PROCEDURE ShowItemExitAlert@8053042(FieldNo_P@8053001 : Integer);
    VAR
      ItemExistance_L@8053002 : Record 8053225;
      SalesLine_L@8053000 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20130724-NUT07-CMC02.02.00-BRA01
      IF HideValidationDialog OR (NOT GUIALLOWED) THEN
       EXIT;
      IF "Document Type" <> "Document Type"::Order THEN
        EXIT;

      // --> 20140919-APP21-TER01.01.00-PDC01
      IF Distrib_G OR "To Distribute" THEN
        EXIT;
      // <-- 20140919-APP21-TER01.01.00-PDC01

      IF (ItemExistance_L.GET(ItemExistance_L.Type::Item,"No.")) OR
         (ItemExistance_L.GET(ItemExistance_L.Type::Species,"Species Code")) OR
         (ItemExistance_L.GET(ItemExistance_L.Type::"Sub-family","Sub-Family Code")) OR
         (ItemExistance_L.GET(ItemExistance_L.Type::Family,"Family Code")) OR
         (ItemExistance_L.GET(ItemExistance_L.Type::Activity,"Activity Code"))
      THEN BEGIN
        IF ItemExistance_L."Use Requested Delivery Date" AND ("Requested Delivery Date" = 0D) THEN
          EXIT;
        IF (FieldNo_P = FIELDNO("Requested Delivery Date")) AND (NOT ItemExistance_L."Use Requested Delivery Date") THEN
          EXIT;
        SalesLine_L.RESET;
        SalesLine_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type",Type,"No.","Species Code","Sub-Family Code","Family Code","Activity Code",
          "Outstanding Quantity");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE(SalesLine_L."Document Type",SalesLine_L."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE(SalesLine_L."Sell-to Customer No.","Sell-to Customer No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE(SalesLine_L.Type,SalesLine_L.Type::Item);
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE(SalesLine_L."No.","No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETFILTER(SalesLine_L."Outstanding Quantity",'>0');
        SalesLine_L.SETFILTER("Document No.",'<>%1',"Document No.");
        IF (ItemExistance_L."Use Requested Delivery Date") THEN
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Requested Delivery Date","Requested Delivery Date");
        IF SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN
          IF CurrFieldNo <> 0 THEN
            MESSAGE(STRSUBSTNO(Text8053080,"No.",SalesLine_L."Document No."));
      END;
      // <-- 20130724-NUT07-CMC02.02.00-BRA01
    END;

    PROCEDURE IsDueDateManuallyEditable@8053056() : Boolean;
    VAR
      Season_L@8053000 : Record 8053154;
    BEGIN
      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Checks if the user is allowed to edit manually "Due Date" field
      // Input: -
      // Output: - boolean

    PROCEDURE CalculateNewDueDate@8053047() : Date;
    VAR
      Season_L@8053000 : Record 8053154;
      NewDueDate_L@8053001 : Date;
      DateExpr_L@8053002 : Text[30];
    BEGIN
      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Calculates  "Due Date" field
      // Input: -
      // Output: - new calculated "Due Date"
      //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // --> 20130812-App17-CMC02.02.00-BSI01
      // --> 20150506-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2979-FHS01
      IF "Season ID No." = 0 THEN
        ERROR(Text8053023, "Document Type", "Document No.", "Line No.");
      // <-- 20150506-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-2979-FHS01
      Season_L.GET("Season ID No.");

      IF "Due Pivot Date Gap" >= 0 THEN
        DateExpr_L := '+' + FORMAT("Due Pivot Date Gap") + 'M'
      ELSE
        DateExpr_L := FORMAT("Due Pivot Date Gap") + 'M' ;

      NewDueDate_L := CALCDATE(DateExpr_L,Season_L."Reference Date");

      IF Season_L."Due Date Starting Date" <> 0D THEN
        IF NewDueDate_L < Season_L."Due Date Starting Date" THEN
          ERROR(Text8060995,NewDueDate_L,Season_L."Due Date Starting Date");
      IF Season_L."Due Date Ending Date" <> 0D THEN
        IF NewDueDate_L > Season_L."Due Date Ending Date" THEN
          ERROR(Text8060996,NewDueDate_L,Season_L."Due Date Ending Date");
      EXIT(NewDueDate_L);
      // <-- 20130812-App17-CMC02.02.00-BSI01
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateQteKitsalesLine@8053052(Quantity_P@8053005 : Decimal;QuantityType_P@8053004 : 'Qte,Qte to ship,Qte to invoice,Return Qty to Receive');
    VAR
      SalesLineKit_L@8053003 : Record 37;
      UnitPrice_L@8053002 : Decimal;
      NetUnitPrice_L@8053001 : Decimal;
      LineDiscount_L@8053000 : Decimal;
      SumQty_L@1000000000 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20130923-Nut08-CMC02.02.00-WSA01
      // mise . jour lignes frais annexes
      // --> 20160802-Nut08-ADV01.01.00-20894-OAN01
      GetSalesHeader;
      IF (SalesHeader."Document Type" = SalesHeader."Document Type"::"Credit Memo") AND NOT SalesHeader.Ship THEN
        EXIT;
      // <-- 20160802-Nut08-ADV01.01.00-20894-OAN01
      SalesLineKit_L.RESET;
      SalesLineKit_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type","Document No.");
      SalesLineKit_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
      SalesLineKit_L.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
      SalesLineKit_L.SETRANGE("Item Charge Root Line No.","Line No.");
      IF SalesLineKit_L.FINDSET(TRUE,FALSE) THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          UnitPrice_L := SalesLineKit_L."Unit Price";
          NetUnitPrice_L := SalesLineKit_L."Net Unit Price";
          SalesLineKit_L.SetFromDirectShip(TRUE);
          CASE QuantityType_P OF
            QuantityType_P::Qte :
              SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE(Quantity,ROUND(Quantity_P * SalesLineKit_L."Item Charge Quantity Per" ,0.00001));

            QuantityType_P::"Qte to ship" : BEGIN
              // --> 20160727-Nut08-ADV01.01.00-20878-OAN01
              IF FromDefalquerSalesLine_G THEN
                SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE(Quantity,SalesLineKit_L."Quantity Shipped")
              ELSE BEGIN
              // <-- 20160727-NUT08-ADV01.01.00-20878-OAN01
              // --> 20150721-NUT08-ADV01.01.00-1973-DRN01
              IF "Qty. to Ship" + "Quantity Shipped" = Quantity  THEN
                SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Ship",SalesLineKit_L."Outstanding Quantity")
              ELSE
              // <-- 20150721-NUT08-ADV01.01.00-1973-DRN01
              SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Ship",ROUND(Quantity_P * SalesLineKit_L."Item Charge Quantity Per" ,0.00001));
              END;
            END;

            QuantityType_P::"Qte to invoice" :
              // --> 20150721-NUT08-ADV01.01.00-1973-DRN01
              IF "Qty. to Invoice" + "Quantity Invoiced" = Quantity  THEN
                SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Invoice",SalesLineKit_L.Quantity - SalesLineKit_L."Quantity Invoiced")
              ELSE
              // <-- 20150721-NUT08-ADV01.01.00-1973-DRN01
              SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Invoice",ROUND(Quantity_P * SalesLineKit_L."Item Charge Quantity Per" ,0.00001));

            // --> 20160802-Nut08-ADV01.01.00-20894-OAN01
            QuantityType_P::"Return Qty to Receive":
              IF "Return Qty. to Receive" + "Return Qty. Received" = Quantity  THEN
                SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Return Qty. to Receive",SalesLineKit_L.Quantity - SalesLineKit_L."Return Qty. Received")
              ELSE
                SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Return Qty. to Receive",ROUND(Quantity_P * SalesLineKit_L."Item Charge Quantity Per" ,0.00001))
      ;
            // <- 20160802-Nut08-ADV01.01.00-20894-OAN01
          END;
          // --> 20150720-NUT08-ADV01.01.00-1973-DRN01
          SumQty_L += ROUND(Quantity_P * SalesLineKit_L."Item Charge Quantity Per" ,0.00001);
          // <-- 20150720-NUT08-ADV01.01.00-1973-DRN01
          SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Unit Price",UnitPrice_L);
          SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Net Unit Price",NetUnitPrice_L);
          SalesLineKit_L.MODIFY;
          SalesLineKit_L.ItemChargeAssignment(SalesLineKit_L);
        UNTIL SalesLineKit_L.NEXT = 0;

        // --> 20150721-NUT08-ADV01.01.00-1973-DRN01
        // On r'partit l''cart d'arrondi sur la deniSre ligne de frais annexe
        // --> 20160727-NUT08-ADV01.01.00-20878-OAN01
        // BEFORE
        {IF SumQty_L <> Quantity_P THEN BEGIN}
        // AFTER
        IF (SumQty_L <> Quantity_P) AND NOT FromDefalquerSalesLine_G THEN BEGIN
        // <-- 20160727-NUT08-ADV01.01.00-20878-OAN01
          CASE QuantityType_P OF
            QuantityType_P::Qte :
              SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE(Quantity,SalesLineKit_L.Quantity + (Quantity_P-SumQty_L));
            QuantityType_P::"Qte to ship" :
              IF "Qty. to Ship" + "Quantity Shipped" = Quantity  THEN
                SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Ship",SalesLineKit_L."Outstanding Quantity")
              ELSE
                SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Ship",SalesLineKit_L."Qty. to Ship" + (Quantity_P-SumQty_L));
            QuantityType_P::"Qte to invoice" :
              IF "Qty. to Invoice" + "Quantity Invoiced" = Quantity  THEN
                SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Invoice",SalesLineKit_L.Quantity - SalesLineKit_L."Quantity Invoiced")
              ELSE
                SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Invoice",SalesLineKit_L."Qty. to Invoice" + (Quantity_P-SumQty_L));
          END;
          SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Unit Price",UnitPrice_L);
          SalesLineKit_L.VALIDATE("Net Unit Price",NetUnitPrice_L);
          SalesLineKit_L.MODIFY;
          SalesLineKit_L.ItemChargeAssignment(SalesLineKit_L);
        END;
        // <-- 20150721-NUT08-ADV01.01.00-1973-DRN01
      END;
      // <-- 20130923-Nut08-CMC02.02.00-WSA01
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateQtyToShipFreeProduct_Old@1000000001();
    VAR
      recSalesLine_L@1000000000 : Record 37;
      QtyToShipOnFreeProduct_L@8053000 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Met . jour la quantit' . livr' de la ligne de produit gratuit en fonction de la ligne principale
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      //  Entr'es
      //  Sorties
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // --> 20131015-App12-CMC02.02.00-917-FHU02
      IF SkipUpdateFreeProduct_G = TRUE THEN
        EXIT;
      IF "Free Item Root Line" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
        //ligne gratuite
        IF recSalesLine_L.GET("Document Type", "Document No.", "Free Item Root Line") THEN BEGIN
          //on a trouv' la ligne principale
          IF "Quantity Shipped" <> Quantity THEN BEGIN
            //Livraison possible
            IF recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
              IF Quantity <> ("Qty. to Ship" + "Quantity Shipped") THEN BEGIN
                VALIDATE("Qty. to Ship", Quantity - "Quantity Shipped")
              END;
            END;
          END;
        END;
        UpdateICAssignment();
      END ELSE BEGIN
        //on est sur une ligne principale
        recSalesLine_L.RESET;
        recSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type", "Document Type");
        recSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.", "Document No.");
        recSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Free Item Root Line", "Line No.");
        IF recSalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          //on a trouv' la ligne de produit gratuit
          IF recSalesLine_L."Quantity Shipped" <> recSalesLine_L.Quantity THEN BEGIN
            //Livraison possible
            IF "Qty. to Ship" > 0 THEN BEGIN
              IF (recSalesLine_L.Quantity <> recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship") OR
                 (ABS(recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship") > ("Quantity Shipped" + "Qty. to Ship"))
              THEN BEGIN
                recSalesLine_L.SkipFreeProduct(TRUE);
                QtyToShipOnFreeProduct_L := recSalesLine_L.Quantity - recSalesLine_L."Quantity Shipped";
                IF ABS(QtyToShipOnFreeProduct_L) > ("Quantity Shipped" + "Qty. to Ship") THEN BEGIN
                  QtyToShipOnFreeProduct_L :=
                    - ROUND(
                      ("Quantity Shipped" + "Qty. to Ship") * ABS(recSalesLine_L.Quantity / Quantity),0.00001, '=');
                END;
                recSalesLine_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Ship", QtyToShipOnFreeProduct_L);
                recSalesLine_L.UpdateICAssignment();
              END;
            END ELSE BEGIN
              IF recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
                recSalesLine_L.SkipFreeProduct(TRUE);
                recSalesLine_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Ship", 0);
              END;
            END;
          END;
          recSalesLine_L.MODIFY;
        END;
      END;
      //<-- 20131015-App12-CMC02.02.00-917-FHU02
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckAuthoMaxQty@8053057();
    VAR
      MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L@8053000 : Record 8053346;
      QtyToCheck_L@8053001 : Decimal;
      cduSalesPriceDiscMgt_L@8053002 : Codeunit 8053017;
      Item_L@8053003 : Record 27;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20140207-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-1681-FEC01
      IF NOT (ActivateQtyCheck_G OR (CurrFieldNo IN [FIELDNO(Quantity),FIELDNO("Purchasing Code")])) THEN
        EXIT;

      IF Quantity = 0 THEN
        EXIT;

      IF Type <> Type::Item THEN
        EXIT;

      Item_L.GET("No.");

      MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.RESET;
      MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
      MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE("Purchasing Code","Purchasing Code");
      MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETFILTER("Packaging Type",'%1|%2',Item_L."Packaging Type",'');
      MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE(Type,MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.Type::Item);
      MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE("No.","No.");
      IF NOT MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE(Type,MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.Type::Species);
        MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE("No.","Species Code");
        IF NOT MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE(Type,MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.Type::Subfamily);
          MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE("No.","Sub-Family Code");
          IF NOT MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE(Type,MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.Type::Family);
            MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE("No.","Family Code");
            IF NOT MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
              MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE(Type,MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.Type::Activity);
              MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.SETRANGE("No.","Activity Code");
              IF NOT MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                EXIT;
              END;
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;

      MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L.TESTFIELD("Unit of Measure Code");
      IF "Unit of Measure Code" = MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Unit of Measure Code" THEN
        QtyToCheck_L := Quantity
      ELSE
        QtyToCheck_L := Quantity *
          cduSalesPriceDiscMgt_L.ConvertUnitofMeasure(MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Unit of Measure Code","Unit of Measure Code","No.");
      CASE MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Check Type" OF
        MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Check Type"::"Max Quantity" :
          IF QtyToCheck_L > MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Max Quantity" THEN
            ERROR(Text8053069,MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Max Quantity",MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Unit of Measure Code");
        MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Check Type"::"Min. Quantity" :
          IF QtyToCheck_L < MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Max Quantity" THEN
            ERROR(Text8053070,MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Max Quantity",MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Unit of Measure Code");
        MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Check Type"::"Indiv. Quantity" :
          IF ((QtyToCheck_L MOD MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Max Quantity")<>0) THEN
            ERROR(Text8053071,MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Max Quantity",MaxQtyOnSalesDoc_L."Unit of Measure Code");
      END;
      // <-- 20140207-Wi00-CMC02.02.00-1681-FEC03
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateECDUnitAmount@8053065();
    BEGIN
      // --> 20140905-APP33-CMC02.02.00-FDA01
      IF Type <> Type::Item THEN EXIT;

      CASE "ECD Calculation Priority" OF
        "ECD Calculation Priority"::"ECD Value" : BEGIN
          IF (CurrFieldNo <> FIELDNO("Budgeted Unit Price")) THEN BEGIN
            "Budgeted Unit Price" := "Net Unit Price" - "ECD Unit Amount";
            IF "Budgeted Unit Price" < 0 THEN
              ERROR(Text8053077,FIELDCAPTION("Budgeted Unit Price"));
          END;
        END;
        "ECD Calculation Priority"::"Budgeted Unit Price" : BEGIN
          "ECD Unit Amount" := "Net Unit Price" - "Budgeted Unit Price";
          IF "ECD Unit Amount" < 0 THEN BEGIN
          // --> 20150126-APP01-TER01.01.00-SDE02
            CMCSetup_G.GET;
            IF CMCSetup_G."TERNOVEO Tariff" = FALSE THEN BEGIN // exception TERNOVEO
            "Budgeted Unit Price" := "Net Unit Price";
            "ECD Unit Amount" := 0;
          END;
          // <-- 20150126-APP01-TER01.01.00-SDE02
          END;
        END;
      END;
      // <-- 20140905-APP33-CMC02.02.00-FDA01
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateQtyToShipFreeProduct@1000000011();
    VAR
      recSalesLine_L@1000000000 : Record 37;
      QtyToShipOnFreeProduct_L@8053000 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // 20150617-app12-CMC02.02.00-ID12583-SP917-JLT01 : Calcule la quantit' . livrer des gratuits
      // ancienne version sous UpdateQtyToShipFreeProduct_Old
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Met . jour la quantit' . livr' de la ligne de produit gratuit en fonction de la ligne principale
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      //  Entr'es
      //  Sorties
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      IF SkipUpdateFreeProduct_G = TRUE THEN EXIT;

      IF "Free Item Root Line" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
        //on est sur une ligne gratuite
        IF recSalesLine_L.GET("Document Type", "Document No.", "Free Item Root Line") THEN BEGIN //cherche la ligne origine
          IF "Free Item Qty Per"=0 THEN
            recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship":=0
          ELSE
            recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship":=ROUND("Qty. to Ship"/"Free Item Qty Per",0.00001,'>');
          IF recSalesLine_L.Quantity<(recSalesLine_L."Quantity Shipped" + recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship") THEN
            recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship":=recSalesLine_L.Quantity-recSalesLine_L."Quantity Shipped";
          recSalesLine_L.UpdateICAssignment();
          EXIT;
        END ELSE
          EXIT;
      END;

        //on est sur une ligne principale
      // --> 20171226-WI00-ADV01.01.00-32168-FBE01
      // Si N› Ligne = 0 alors on va mettre . jour la premiSre ligne de la commande avec "Free Item Root Line" = 0
      IF "Line No." = 0 THEN
        EXIT;
      // <-- 20171226-WI00-ADV01.01.00-32168-FBE01
        recSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type", "Document Type");
        recSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.", "Document No.");
        recSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Free Item Root Line", "Line No.");
        IF recSalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN //cherche la ligne de produit gratuit
          IF Quantity=("Quantity Shipped" + "Qty. to Ship") THEN  // si on livre tout, on solde les gratuits
            recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship":=recSalesLine_L.Quantity-recSalesLine_L."Quantity Shipped"
          ELSE
            recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship":=ROUND("Qty. to Ship"*recSalesLine_L."Free Item Qty Per",0.00001);
          IF recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship" < recSalesLine_L.Quantity-recSalesLine_L."Quantity Shipped" THEN
            recSalesLine_L."Qty. to Ship":=recSalesLine_L.Quantity-recSalesLine_L."Quantity Shipped";
        recSalesLine_L.SkipFreeProduct(TRUE);
        recSalesLine_L.VALIDATE("Qty. to Ship");
        recSalesLine_L.UpdateICAssignment();
        recSalesLine_L.MODIFY;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE RefreshMixSalesLines@60004();
    VAR
      KitReservEntry@60004 : Record 337;
      WhseShptLine@60003 : Record 7321;
      WhseActivLine@60002 : Record 5767;
      CapableToPromise@60001 : Codeunit 99000886;
      MixSalesManagement_L@60005 : Codeunit 60007;
      KitUnitPrice@60000 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20140924-APP28-TER01.01.00-RMZ01
      // This function is a copy of RefreshKitSalesLines
      // Input
      // Output

      {
      TESTFIELD("Build Kit",TRUE);
      VALIDATE("Build Kit",TRUE);
      ForceKitRefresh := TRUE;
      MODIFY(TRUE);
      ForceKitRefresh := FALSE;
      }

      TestStatusOpen;

      IF NOT ("Document Type" IN
        ["Document Type"::Quote,"Document Type"::Order,"Document Type"::Invoice,"Document Type"::"Blanket Order"])
      THEN
        FIELDERROR("Document Type",STRSUBSTNO(Text043,"Document Type"));

      TESTFIELD(Type,Type::Item);
      TESTFIELD("No.");
      Item.GET("No.");

      TESTFIELD("Appl.-to Item Entry",0);
      TESTFIELD("Job No.",'');
      TESTFIELD("Quantity Shipped",0);
      TESTFIELD("Prepmt. Amt. Inv.",0);
      IF Item."Mix BOM No." <> '' THEN BEGIN
        TESTFIELD(Reserve,Reserve::Never);
        TESTFIELD("Drop Shipment",FALSE);
        TESTFIELD("Special Order",FALSE);
        TESTFIELD(Quantity,0);
        MixSalesManagement_L.RefreshTempKitSales(Rec,TempMixSalesLine_G);
        GetItem;
        IF Item."Roll-up Kit Pricing" = Item."Roll-up Kit Pricing"::Always THEN BEGIN
          MixSalesManagement_L.GetTotalKitPrice(KitUnitPrice,TempMixSalesLine_G);
          VALIDATE("Unit Price",KitUnitPrice);
        END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF NOT TempMixSalesLine_G.FINDSET THEN
           MixSalesManagement_L.GetKitSales(Rec,TempMixSalesLine_G);
        IF TempMixSalesLine_G.FINDSET THEN
          IF CONFIRM(Text25000,TRUE,FIELDCAPTION("Build Kit")) THEN BEGIN
            IF WhseValidateSourceLine.WhseLinesExist(
               DATABASE::"Sales Line",
               "Document Type",
               "Document No.",
               "Line No.",
               0,
               Quantity)
            THEN
              ERROR(Text25003,WhseShptLine.TABLECAPTION);
            IF WhseValidateSourceLine.WhseLinesExist2(
                 DATABASE::"Mix Sales Line",
                 "Document Type",
                 "Document No.",
                 "Line No.")
            THEN
              ERROR(Text25003,WhseActivLine.TABLECAPTION);
            KitReservEntry.RESET;
            KitReservEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(
              "Source ID","Source Ref. No.","Source Type","Source Subtype",
              "Source Batch Name","Source Prod. Order Line","Reservation Status");
            KitReservEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Mix Sales Line");
            KitReservEntry.SETRANGE("Source Subtype","Document Type");
            KitReservEntry.SETRANGE("Source ID","Document No.");
            KitReservEntry.SETRANGE("Source Batch Name",'');
            KitReservEntry.SETRANGE("Source Prod. Order Line","Line No.");
            KitReservEntry.SETFILTER("Item Tracking",'> %1',KitReservEntry."Item Tracking"::None);
            IF KitReservEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
              IF CONFIRM(Text25002,FALSE) THEN
                TempMixSalesLine_G.DELETEALL
              ELSE
                ERROR(Text25001);
            END ELSE
              TempMixSalesLine_G.DELETEALL
          END ELSE
            ERROR(Text25001);
      END;

      //CheckItemAvailable(FIELDNO("Build Kit"));
      CapableToPromise.RemoveReqLines("Document No.","Line No.",0,0,FALSE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE FillMixLines@60007(ForThisVersion_P@60008 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      MixSalesLine_L@60004 : Record 60032;
      MixBomLine_L@60003 : Record 60026;
      LineNo_L@60002 : Integer;
      VersionMgt_L@60001 : Codeunit 60000;
      MixSalesMgt_L@60007 : Codeunit 60007;
      ActiveVersionCode_L@60000 : Code[20];
      "<<-- 3LI TEXTCONSTANTS -->>"@60006 : TextConst;
      Text60000@60005 : TextConst 'ENU=For the nomenclature mix don''t exist a current version;FRA=Pour le nomenclature de m'lange n''existe pas une version courante';
    BEGIN
      // --> 20140924-APP28-TER01.01.00-RMZ01
      // This function will create lines on the table Mix Sales Line
      // Input
      //   - ForThisVersion_P
      // Output
      IF (Type <> Type::Item) OR ("No." = '') OR (Quantity = 0) THEN
        EXIT;
      Item.GET("No.");
      IF Item."Mix BOM No." = '' THEN
        EXIT;
      CLEAR(MixSalesLine_L);
      MixSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
      MixSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
      MixSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Line No.","Line No.");
      IF NOT MixSalesLine_L.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE) THEN BEGIN
        LineNo_L := 10000;
        IF ForThisVersion_P <> '' THEN
          ActiveVersionCode_L := ForThisVersion_P
        ELSE
          ActiveVersionCode_L := VersionMgt_L.GetBOMVersion(Item."Mix BOM No.",WORKDATE,TRUE);

        // --> 20141027-APP28-TER01.01.00-RMZ01 -- the following lines as been change to comment
        //IF ActiveVersionCode_L = '' THEN
        //  ERROR(Text60000);
        // <-- 20141027-APP28-TER01.01.00-RMZ01

        // --> 20150429-APP28-TER01.01.00-397-RMZ01
        CheckMixCertified;
        // <-- 20150429-APP28-TER01.01.00-397-RMZ01

        "Mix BOM No." := Item."Mix BOM No.";
        "Mix BOM Version Code" := ActiveVersionCode_L;
        // --> 20151202-APP28-TER01.01.00-2500-JCD01
        {BEFORE Suppression modify
        MODIFY;
        }
        // <-- 20151202-APP28-TER01.01.00-2500-JCD01

        // --> 20151211-APP28-TER01.01.00-2500-CJY01
        IF NOT SkipShowingMix_G THEN
          MODIFY;
        // <-- 20151211-APP28-TER01.01.00-2500-CJY01

        CLEAR(MixBomLine_L);
        MixBomLine_L.SETRANGE("Mix BOM No.",Item."Mix BOM No.");
        MixBomLine_L.SETRANGE("Version Code",ActiveVersionCode_L);
        MixBomLine_L.SETFILTER(Type,'%1|%2',MixBomLine_L.Type::Item,MixBomLine_L.Type::Resource);
        MixBomLine_L.FINDSET(FALSE,FALSE);
        REPEAT
          CLEAR(MixSalesLine_L);
          // --> 20141105-APP28-TER01.01.00-PDC01
          MixSalesLine_L.SuspendStatusCheck(TRUE);
          // <-- 20141105-APP28-TER01.01.00-PDC01
          // --> 20151202-APP28-TER01.01.00-2500-JCD01
          MixSalesLine_L.SetKitLine(Rec);
          // <-- 20151202-APP28-TER01.01.00-2500-JCD01
          MixSalesLine_L."Document Type" := "Document Type";
          MixSalesLine_L."Document No." := "Document No.";
          MixSalesLine_L."Document Line No." := "Line No.";
          MixSalesLine_L."Line No." := LineNo_L;
          CASE MixBomLine_L.Type OF

    PROCEDURE LookupMixTypesAllowed@60008(LookupActive_P@60003 : Boolean);
    VAR
      "<<-- 3LI LOCALS -->>"@60002 : Integer;
      MixBOMHeader_L@60001 : Record 60025;
      MixAllowByLoc_L@60000 : Record 60033;
      MixTypeAllowedList_L@60004 : Page 60052;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20140924-APP28-TER01.01.00-RMZ01
      // This function will validate the mix types allowed by location
      // Input
      //   - LookupActive_P
      // Output
      TESTFIELD("Document No.");
      TESTFIELD("Line No.");
      TESTFIELD(Type,Type::Item);
      TESTFIELD("No.");
      Item.GET("No.");
      Item.TESTFIELD("Mix BOM No.");

      CLEAR(MixBOMHeader_L);
      MixBOMHeader_L.SETRANGE("No.",Item."Mix BOM No.");
      MixBOMHeader_L.FINDFIRST;
      IF NOT LookupActive_P THEN BEGIN
        CLEAR(MixAllowByLoc_L);
        MixAllowByLoc_L.SETRANGE("Location Code","Location Code Prod. Mix");
        MixAllowByLoc_L.SETRANGE("Mix Type",MixBOMHeader_L."Mix Type");
        MixAllowByLoc_L.FINDFIRST;
      END
      ELSE BEGIN
        CLEAR(MixAllowByLoc_L);
        MixAllowByLoc_L.FILTERGROUP := 2;
        MixAllowByLoc_L.SETRANGE("Mix Type",MixBOMHeader_L."Mix Type");
        CLEAR(MixTypeAllowedList_L);
        MixTypeAllowedList_L.LOOKUPMODE := TRUE;
        MixTypeAllowedList_L.SETTABLEVIEW(MixAllowByLoc_L);
        IF MixTypeAllowedList_L.RUNMODAL = ACTION::LookupOK THEN BEGIN
          MixTypeAllowedList_L.GETRECORD(MixAllowByLoc_L);
          "Location Code Prod. Mix" := MixAllowByLoc_L."Location Code";
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckInvoiceFarmer@1000000007(ToDelete_P@1000000002 : Boolean);
    VAR
      "<<-- 3LI TEXTCONTSTANTS -->>"@1000000000 : TextConst;
      Text60000@1000000001 : TextConst 'ENU=It is not possible to delete or modify the line. You must delete the document header.;FRA=Vous ne pouvez pas supprimer ou modifier la ligne. Vous devez supprimer l''ent^te du document.';
      "<<--- 3LI LOCALS --->>"@1000000003 : Integer;
      MatifInvLink_L@1000000004 : Record 60064;
    BEGIN
      // 20150507-CER126-TER01.01.00-346-RMZ01
      // This function will check if this is a document to invoice a farmer contract
      // Input
      //    - ToDelete_P
      // Output
      // --> 20151012-CER73-TER01.01.00-2365-RMZ01 : the following lines as been commented
      //IF ToSkipInvoiceFarmer_G THEN
      //  EXIT;
      // <-- 20151012-CER73-TER01.01.00-2365-RMZ01
      GetSalesHeader;
      IF SalesHeader."CMC MATIF Contract Arb-Far No." <> '' THEN BEGIN
        IF ToDelete_P THEN BEGIN
          // --> 20151012-CER73-TER01.01.00-2365-RMZ01
          // Before
          //  ERROR(Text60000);
          // After
          IF "Document Type" IN ["Document Type"::Invoice,"Document Type"::"Credit Memo"] THEN BEGIN
            CLEAR(MatifInvLink_L);
            MatifInvLink_L.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type","Document No.","Document Line No.");

              MatifInvLink_L.SETRANGE("Document Type",MatifInvLink_L."Document Type"::Invoice)
            ELSE

            MatifInvLink_L.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
            MatifInvLink_L.SETRANGE("Document Line No.","Line No.");
            MatifInvLink_L.DELETEALL;
          END;
          EXIT;
        END;
        // <-- 20151012-CER73-TER01.01.00-2365-RMZ01
        IF (xRec.Type <> Type) OR (xRec."No." <> "No.") OR (xRec.Description <> Description) OR (xRec.Quantity <> Quantity)
              OR (xRec."Unit Price" <> "Unit Price") THEN

    PROCEDURE CheckActiveForSales@1000000012();
    VAR
      Item_L@1000000002 : Record 27;
      ItemVariant_L@1000000001 : Record 5401;
      AvailableToPromisecdu_L@1000000008 : Codeunit 5790;
      AvailStock_L@1000000000 : Decimal;
      GrossRequirement_L@1000000007 : Decimal;
      ScheduledReceipt_L@1000000006 : Decimal;
      PeriodType_L@1000000005 : 'Day,Week,Month,Quarter,Year';
      AvailabilityDate_L@1000000004 : Date;
      LookaheadDateformula_L@1000000003 : DateFormula;
      SalesHeader_L@1000000010 : Record 36;
      CMCCRMConnectorSetup_L@1000000009 : Record 8053602;
    BEGIN
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      //  V'rifie si la ligne peut ^tre vendue suivant la rSsgle de gestion
      //  (Refactoring de code. RSgle transf'e . partid
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Entr'es:
      //   - N/A
      // Sorties:
      //   - N/A
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

      //-->20151023-WI00-ADV01.01.00-2420-DGL01
      {BEFORE
      CMCCRMConnectorSetup_L.GET;
      AFTER}
      IF NOT CMCCRMConnectorSetup_L.GET THEN
        CMCCRMConnectorSetup_L.INIT;
      //<--20151023-WI00-ADV01.01.00-2420-DGL01

      CMCSetup_G.GET;
      SalesHeader_L.GET("Document Type","Document No.");
      IF ("Document Type" IN ["Document Type"::Order,"Document Type"::"Return Order"])
       AND(
      //-->20151019-WI00-ADV01.01.00-2125-DGL02
      {BEFORE
        (CMCCRMConnectorSetup_L."Document Source Simple Order" = "Document Source")
      AFTER}
        ((CMCCRMConnectorSetup_L."Document Source Simple Order" = SalesHeader_L."Document Source")
         AND ((UPPERCASE(USERID) = CMCCRMConnectorSetup_L."CRM Connector Service User")
              OR ((UPPERCASE(USERID) <> CMCCRMConnectorSetup_L."CRM Connector Service User")
                  AND NOT(SalesHeader_L."Released Once" AND CMCSetup_G."No Blocking Ctrl on Relaunch"))))
      //<--20151019-WI00-ADV01.01.00-2125-DGL02
        OR
        ((CMCCRMConnectorSetup_L."Document Source Simple Order" <> SalesHeader_L."Document Source")
          AND NOT(SalesHeader_L."Released Once" AND CMCSetup_G."No Blocking Ctrl on Relaunch"))
       )
       THEN BEGIN
        IF (Type = Type::Item) AND ("Document Type"="Document Type"::Order) THEN BEGIN
          Item_L.GET("No.");
          IF "Variant Code"<>'' THEN
            ItemVariant_L.GET("No.","Variant Code") ;
          IF (Item_L."Blocked For Sales")  OR (ItemVariant_L."Blocked For Sales") THEN BEGIN
            IF "Shipment Date" <> 0D THEN
              AvailabilityDate_L := "Shipment Date"
            ELSE
              AvailabilityDate_L := WORKDATE;

            Item_L.RESET;
            Item_L.SETRANGE("Date Filter",0D,AvailabilityDate_L);
            Item_L.SETRANGE("Variant Filter","Variant Code");
            Item_L.SETRANGE("Location Filter","Location Code");
            Item_L.SETRANGE("Drop Shipment Filter",FALSE);

            AvailStock_L := AvailableToPromisecdu_L.QtyAvailabletoPromise(
              Item_L,GrossRequirement_L,ScheduledReceipt_L,AvailabilityDate_L,
              PeriodType_L,LookaheadDateformula_L);

            IF AvailStock_L + xRec.Quantity < Quantity THEN
              // --> 20161122-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3109-JCD01
              {BEFORE
              ERROR(Text8053007,AvailStock_L + xRec.Quantity);
              AFTER}
              IF NOT FromDefalquerSalesLine_G THEN
              ERROR(Text8053007,AvailStock_L + xRec.Quantity);
              // <-- 20161122-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3109-JCD01
          END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateQtyAutoFreeProductLine@1000000014();
    VAR
      SalesLine_L@1000000000 : Record 37;
      Item_L@1000000001 : Record 27;
      SalesSetup_L@1000000002 : Record 311;
    BEGIN
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Cette fonction met . jour la qt' la ligne de produit gratuit pour les articles param'tr's "Autoriser produit gratuit"
      // = Automatique
      //
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Entr'es:
      //
      // Sorties:
      //
      //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

      // --> 20151116-APP12-ADV01.01.00-2376-DGL01
      TESTFIELD(Type,Type::Item);
      TESTFIELD("No.");
      Item_L.GET("No.");
      // --> 20160517-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-2986-JCD01
      IF Item_L."Allow Free Product" = Item_L."Allow Free Product"::No THEN
        EXIT;
      // <-- 20160517-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-2986-JCD01
      SalesSetup_L.GET;

      // --> 20160517-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-2986-JCD01
      {BEFORE
      IF (Item_L."Allow Free Product" = Item_L."Allow Free Product"::Automatic) AND ("Quantity Shipped" = 0) THEN BEGIN
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Free Item Root Line","Line No.");
        SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("No.",SalesSetup_L."Free Item Item Charge No.");
        IF SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          IF SalesLine_L.Quantity = - xRec.Quantity THEN BEGIN
            SalesLine_L.VALIDATE(Quantity,-Quantity);
            SalesLine_L.MODIFY;
          END;
        END;
      END;
      // <-- 20151116-APP12-ADV01.01.00-2376-DGL01
      AFTER}

      IF "Quantity Shipped" = 0 THEN BEGIN
        IF (Item_L."Allow Free Product" = Item_L."Allow Free Product"::Automatic) THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Free Item Root Line","Line No.");
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("No.",SalesSetup_L."Free Item Item Charge No.");
          IF SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            IF SalesLine_L.Quantity = - xRec.Quantity THEN BEGIN
              SalesLine_L.VALIDATE(Quantity,-Quantity);
              SalesLine_L.MODIFY;
            END;
          END;
        END ELSE IF (Item_L."Allow Free Product" = Item_L."Allow Free Product"::Manual) THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Free Item Root Line","Line No.");
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("No.",SalesSetup_L."Free Item Item Charge No.");
          IF SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            IF (SalesLine_L."Free Item Qty Per" <> 0) THEN BEGIN
              SalesLine_L.VALIDATE(Quantity,SalesLine_L."Free Item Qty Per" * Quantity);
              SalesLine_L.MODIFY;
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF (Item_L."Allow Free Product" <> Item_L."Allow Free Product"::No) THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Free Item Root Line","Line No.");
          SalesLine_L.SETRANGE("No.",SalesSetup_L."Free Item Item Charge No.");
          IF SalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            IF SalesLine_L."Free Item Qty Per" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
              IF ABS(SalesLine_L."Free Item Qty Per" * Quantity) > ABS(SalesLine_L."Quantity Shipped")  THEN BEGIN
                SalesLine_L.VALIDATE(Quantity,SalesLine_L."Free Item Qty Per" * Quantity);
              END ELSE BEGIN
                SalesLine_L.VALIDATE(Quantity,SalesLine_L."Quantity Shipped");
              END;
              SalesLine_L.MODIFY;
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
      // <-- 20160517-Wi00-ADV01.01.00-2986-JCD01
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateFreeProductQtytoReturn@1000000018();
    VAR
      recSalesLine_L@1000000000 : Record 37;
      QtyToShipOnFreeProduct_L@8053000 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20160705-APP12-ADV01.01.00-3111-OAN01
      IF SkipUpdateFreeProduct_G
        THEN EXIT;

      IF "Free Item Root Line" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
        IF recSalesLine_L.GET("Document Type", "Document No.", "Free Item Root Line") THEN BEGIN
          IF "Free Item Qty Per"=0 THEN
            recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. to Receive" := 0
          ELSE
            recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. to Receive" := ROUND("Return Qty. to Receive" / "Free Item Qty Per",0.00001,'>');
          IF recSalesLine_L.Quantity < (recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. Received" + recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. to Receive") THEN
            recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. to Receive" := recSalesLine_L.Quantity - recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. Received";
          recSalesLine_L.VALIDATE("Return Qty. to Receive");
          recSalesLine_L.UpdateICAssignment();
        END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        recSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document Type", "Document Type");
        recSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Document No.", "Document No.");
        recSalesLine_L.SETRANGE("Free Item Root Line", "Line No.");
        IF recSalesLine_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          IF Quantity = ("Return Qty. Received" + "Return Qty. to Receive") THEN
            recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. to Receive" := recSalesLine_L.Quantity - recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. Received"
          ELSE
            recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. to Receive" := ROUND("Return Qty. to Receive" * recSalesLine_L."Free Item Qty Per",0.00001);
          IF recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. to Receive" < recSalesLine_L.Quantity - recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. Received" THEN
            recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. to Receive" := recSalesLine_L.Quantity - recSalesLine_L."Return Qty. Received";
          recSalesLine_L.SkipFreeProduct(TRUE);
          recSalesLine_L.VALIDATE("Return Qty. to Receive");
          recSalesLine_L.UpdateICAssignment();
          recSalesLine_L.MODIFY;
        END;
      END;
      // <-- 20160705-APP12-ADV01.01.00-3111-OAN01
    END;

    PROCEDURE FillSeasonPoseo@1000000025() : Boolean;
    VAR
      Season_L@8053000 : Record 8053154;
      TmpSeason_L@8053001 : TEMPORARY Record 8053154;
      SeasonLevel_L@1000000000 : Integer;
      TableauType_L@1000000001 : ARRAY [6] OF Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF (SeasonIsFilled_G = FALSE) OR (UpdateFromHeader_G) THEN
        SeasonIsFilled_G := TRUE
      ELSE
        EXIT(TRUE);

      TmpSeason_L.RESET;
      TmpSeason_L.DELETEALL;

      CampaignMgt_G.GetAvailableSeason(TmpSeason_L,Rec);

      IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT = 1 THEN BEGIN
        // Only One Season
        TmpSeason_L.FINDFIRST;
        VALIDATE("Season ID No.", TmpSeason_L."ID No.");
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      // --> 20230322-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3614-CJY01
      {BEFORE
      IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT > 1 THEN BEGIN
        // More Than One Season
        FOR SeasonLevel_L := 5 DOWNTO 1 DO BEGIN
          TmpSeason_L.SETRANGE(Type,SeasonLevel_L-1);
          IF TmpSeason_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT = 1 THEN BEGIN
              VALIDATE("Season ID No.", TmpSeason_L."ID No.");
              EXIT(TRUE);
            END ELSE BEGIN
              TmpSeason_L.SETFILTER("Campaign No.",'<>%1',TmpSeason_L."Campaign No.");
              IF NOT TmpSeason_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                TmpSeason_L.SETRANGE("Campaign No.");
                TmpSeason_L.FINDLAST;
                VALIDATE("Season ID No.", TmpSeason_L."ID No.");
                EXIT(TRUE);
              END;
            END;
          END;
        END;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;
      AFTER}
      TableauType_L[6] := 4;
      TableauType_L[5] := 5;
      TableauType_L[4] := 3;
      TableauType_L[3] := 2;
      TableauType_L[2] := 1;
      TableauType_L[1] := 0;

      IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT > 1 THEN BEGIN
        // More Than One Season
        FOR SeasonLevel_L := 6 DOWNTO 1 DO BEGIN
          TmpSeason_L.SETRANGE(Type,TableauType_L[SeasonLevel_L]);
          IF TmpSeason_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            IF TmpSeason_L.COUNT = 1 THEN BEGIN
              VALIDATE("Season ID No.", TmpSeason_L."ID No.");
              EXIT(TRUE);
            END ELSE BEGIN
              TmpSeason_L.SETFILTER("Campaign No.",'<>%1',TmpSeason_L."Campaign No.");
              IF NOT TmpSeason_L.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                TmpSeason_L.SETRANGE("Campaign No.");
                TmpSeason_L.FINDLAST;
                VALIDATE("Season ID No.", TmpSeason_L."ID No.");
                EXIT(TRUE);
              END;
            END;
          END;
        END;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      // <-- 20230322-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3614-CJY01
    END;

    PROCEDURE ShowResourceAcpAssgnt@1000000024();
    VAR
      ResourceAcpAssgnts_L@1000 : Page 60206;
    BEGIN
      // --> 20200212-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3446-CJY01
      GET("Document Type","Document No.","Line No.");
      IF (("Document Type" = "Document Type"::Invoice) OR ("Document Type" = "Document Type"::"Credit Memo")) THEN BEGIN

        TESTFIELD(Type,Type::Resource);
        TESTFIELD("No.");
        TESTFIELD(Quantity);

        ResourceAcpAssgnt_G.RESET;
        ResourceAcpAssgnt_G.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
        ResourceAcpAssgnt_G.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
        ResourceAcpAssgnt_G.SETRANGE("Document Line No.","Line No.");
        ResourceAcpAssgnt_G.SETRANGE("Resource No.","No.");
        IF NOT ResourceAcpAssgnt_G.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
          ResourceAcpAssgnt_G."Document Type" := "Document Type";
          ResourceAcpAssgnt_G."Document No." := "Document No.";
          ResourceAcpAssgnt_G."Document Line No." := "Line No.";
          ResourceAcpAssgnt_G."Resource No." := "No.";
          GetSalesHeader;
          IF ("Inv. Discount Amount" = 0) AND
             ("Line Discount Amount" = 0) AND
             (NOT SalesHeader."Prices Including VAT")
          THEN
            ResourceAcpAssgnt_G."Unit Cost" := "Unit Price"
          ELSE
            IF SalesHeader."Prices Including VAT" THEN
              ResourceAcpAssgnt_G."Unit Cost" :=
                ROUND(
                  ("Line Amount" - "Inv. Discount Amount") / Quantity / (1 + "VAT %" / 100),
                  Currency."Unit-Amount Rounding Precision")
            ELSE
              ResourceAcpAssgnt_G."Unit Cost" :=
                ROUND(
                  ("Line Amount" - "Inv. Discount Amount") / Quantity,
                  Currency."Unit-Amount Rounding Precision");
        END;

        COMMIT;


        ResourceAcpAssgnts_L.Initialize(Rec,ResourceAcpAssgnt_G."Unit Cost");

        ResourceAcpAssgnts_L.RUNMODAL;
        CALCFIELDS("Qty. to Assign");
      END;
      // <-- 20200212-WI00-ADV01.01.00-3446-CJY01
    END;
